title: 網路入侵偵測工程
summary: 以網路可觀察性、協議解碼與告警品質串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 觀察點：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「觀察點」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For observation points, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「觀察點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏡像完整性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around observation points, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary mirror placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mirror completeness as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 比較「觀察點」與「鏡像完整性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Compare whether evidence for observation points and mirror completeness supports the same inference.
steps.failure: IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「觀察點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for observation points. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。
knowledge.textEn: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「鏡像完整性」：鏡像埠可能超載並丟包。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「觀察點」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring mirror completeness: Mirror ports can overload and drop packets. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove observation points passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 流中 200 異常；偵測 160、正常誤報 100，precision=160/260=61.54%、recall=80%。資料分布改變時這些比率亦改變。
knowledge.textEn: Among 100000 hypothetical flows with 200 anomalies, 160 detections and 100 false positives give precision=61.54% and recall=80%; distribution shifts change these values.

quiz.question: 針對「觀察點」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of observation points?
options: 觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。
IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。
只檢查「鏡像完整性」，便可取代「觀察點」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic.
An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload.
Checking mirror completeness alone replaces verification specific to observation points.
quiz.explanation: 觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。 相鄰的「鏡像完整性」有不同責任：鏡像埠可能超載並丟包。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Neighboring mirror completeness has a different role: Mirror ports can overload and drop packets. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 觀察點：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Observation points: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「觀察點」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For observation points, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「觀察位置決定看見哪些方向與流量。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「鏡像完整性」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Observation placement determines visible directions/traffic. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from mirror completeness to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改鏡像點位置。 比較「觀察點」與「鏡像完整性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary mirror placement. Compare whether evidence for observation points and mirror completeness supports the same inference.
steps.failure: IDS 能直接讀取所有 TLS 加密內文。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An IDS directly reads every TLS-encrypted payload. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「觀察點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for observation points. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.objective: 針對「盲點報告」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For blind-spot reporting, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「盲點報告」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：報告應列明未觀察區域而非聲稱全部防護。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬感測器丟包導致的證據缺口。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「觀察點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

steps.objective: 針對「遠端維護」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For remote maintenance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「遠端維護」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：維護需批准、限時與可歸屬身分。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較管理與程序控制通道的權限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「管理通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Maintenance needs approval, time bounds and attributable identity. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare management/process-control conduit permissions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat management conduits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for remote maintenance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Model isolation failure and predefined safe degradation. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 12 區原本任意雙向連通，共 12×11=132 有向關係；核准流程只需 18 關係，減少 114 個允許方向。這只衡量可達性，不能當作風險降低百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Twelve fully connected zones have 132 directed relationships; approved flows need 18, removing 114 allowed directions. This measures reachability, not a percentage risk reduction.

quiz.question: 針對「離線驗收」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of offline acceptance?
options: 本課使用流矩陣模擬，不掃描真實工控設備。
VLAN 名稱不同即證明所有跨區流量已受控。
只檢查「OT 資產邊界」，便可取代「離線驗收」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: This course simulates flow matrices without scanning live OT equipment.
Different VLAN names prove all interzone flows are controlled.
Checking ot asset boundaries alone replaces verification specific to offline acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 本課使用流矩陣模擬，不掃描真實工控設備。 相鄰的「OT 資產邊界」有不同責任：控制器、感測與工程站有不同安全需求。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: This course simulates flow matrices without scanning live OT equipment. Neighboring ot asset boundaries has a different role: Controllers, sensing and engineering stations have different needs. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想 12 區原本任意雙向連通，共 12×11=132 有向關係；核准流程只需 18 關係，減少 114 個允許方向。這只衡量可達性，不能當作風險降低百分比。
workedExample.textEn: Twelve fully connected zones have 132 directed relationships; approved flows need 18, removing 114 allowed directions. This measures reachability, not a percentage risk reduction.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 物聯網裝置身分驗證
summary: 以裝置根信任、佈建與憑據更新串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect device roots of trust, provisioning and credential renewal through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 裝置識別：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「裝置識別」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For device identifiers, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「裝置識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around device identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat unique credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「裝置識別」與「唯一憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for device identifiers and unique credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「唯一憑據」：個別憑據限制單裝置事故的擴散範圍。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「裝置識別」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring unique credentials: Per-device credentials limit the scope of one-device compromise. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove device identifiers passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 100000 裝置各每日驗證一次，平均 1.1574 次/s；若全於 10 min 內集中，為 166.67 次/s，平均流量不足以規劃驗證尖峰。
knowledge.textEn: 100000 devices authenticating once/day average 1.1574/s; concentrating them into 10 minutes gives 166.67/s, so averages do not size authentication peaks.

quiz.question: 針對「裝置識別」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

options: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。
所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。
只檢查「唯一憑據」，便可取代「裝置識別」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically.
One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free.
Checking unique credentials alone replaces verification specific to device identifiers.
quiz.explanation: 序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。 相鄰的「唯一憑據」有不同責任：個別憑據限制單裝置事故的擴散範圍。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。

steps.title: 裝置識別：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Device identifiers: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「裝置識別」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For device identifiers, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「序號是識別，不一定提供密碼學驗證。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「唯一憑據」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Serial numbers identify devices but need not authenticate cryptographically. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from unique credentials to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定裝置，只改憑據是否唯一。 比較「裝置識別」與「唯一憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix devices and vary credential uniqueness. Compare whether evidence for device identifiers and unique credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有裝置共用一把秘密最容易稽核且無風險。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: One shared fleet secret is easily audited and risk-free. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「裝置識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for device identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

quiz.question: 針對「遠端證明」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？

只檢查「佈建角色」，便可取代「遠端證明」的專屬驗證。

Evaluate the principle: Attestation checks freshness and expected measurements. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix algorithms and vary device-clock quality. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from provisioning roles to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.failure: 看到 CAN ID 就能證明發送裝置身分。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

steps.check: 提交「車載功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for vehicle function maps. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring protection boundaries: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove threat models passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想證明 15 ms、驗證 5 ms、秘密傳送 10 ms，串行初始化合 30 ms；若每秒 100 次初始作業且不可並行，每秒需 3 s 處理，單通道不足。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed attestation=15 ms, verification=5 ms and secret transfer=10 ms give 30 ms serial initialization; 100 starts/s require 3 processing-seconds/s, exceeding one serial channel.

quiz.question: 針對「威胁模型」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of threat models?
options: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。
機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。
只檢查「保護邊界」，便可取代「威胁模型」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first.
Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug.
Checking protection boundaries alone replaces verification specific to threat models.
quiz.explanation: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 相鄰的「保護邊界」有不同責任：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Neighboring protection boundaries has a different role: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 保護邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「保護邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For protection boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「保護邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「記憶體加密」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protection boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat memory encryption as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「保護邊界」與「記憶體加密」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for protection boundaries and memory encryption supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「保護邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for protection boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 保護邊界：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Protection boundaries: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「保護邊界」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For protection boundaries, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「記憶體加密」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from memory encryption to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「保護邊界」與「記憶體加密」的證據是否支持相同推論。

steps.failureEn: The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「保護邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for protection boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「Attester」：產生證據的角色與判斷可信的角色不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「受測工作負載」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring attesters: Evidence generation differs from trust evaluation. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove measured workloads passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「受測工作負載」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of measured workloads?
options: 測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。
證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。
只檢查「Attester」，便可取代「受測工作負載」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations.
The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted.
Checking attesters alone replaces verification specific to measured workloads.
quiz.explanation: 測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。 相鄰的「Attester」有不同責任：產生證據的角色與判斷可信的角色不同。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations. Neighboring attesters has a different role: Evidence generation differs from trust evaluation. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 受測工作負載：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Measured workloads: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「受測工作負載」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For measured workloads, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「Attester」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from attesters to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「受測工作負載」與「Attester」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for measured workloads and attesters supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「受測工作負載」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for measured workloads. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

stages.title: 介面、狀態與資源配置
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Attester：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「Attester」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For attesters, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Attester」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：產生證據的角色與判斷可信的角色不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較新鲜與重放的證明記錄。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Verifier」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around attesters, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence generation differs from trust evaluation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare fresh/replayed attestation records. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat verifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較新鲜與重放的證明記錄。 比較「Attester」與「Verifier」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare fresh/replayed attestation records. Compare whether evidence for attesters and verifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Attester」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for attesters. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.objective: 針對「部署驗收」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For deployment acceptance, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬 host 攻击面之外的應用授權缺陷。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「威胁模型」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from threat models to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬 host 攻击面之外的應用授權缺陷。 比較「部署驗收」與「威胁模型」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Compare whether evidence for deployment acceptance and threat models supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「部署驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for deployment acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。
knowledge.textEn: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「威胁模型」：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「部署驗收」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring threat models: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove deployment acceptance passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬 host 攻击面之外的應用授權缺陷。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model application authorization flaws beyond the host-protection scope. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想證明 15 ms、驗證 5 ms、秘密傳送 10 ms，串行初始化合 30 ms；若每秒 100 次初始作業且不可並行，每秒需 3 s 處理，單通道不足。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed attestation=15 ms, verification=5 ms and secret transfer=10 ms give 30 ms serial initialization; 100 starts/s require 3 processing-seconds/s, exceeding one serial channel.

quiz.question: 針對「部署驗收」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of deployment acceptance?
options: 需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。
證明報告存在便證明其測量值得信任。
只檢查「威胁模型」，便可取代「部署驗收」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection.
The existence of an attestation report proves its measurements trusted.
Checking threat models alone replaces verification specific to deployment acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 需測試錯誤測量、過期證明與授權拒絕。 相鄰的「威胁模型」有不同責任：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Test wrong measurements, stale reports and authorization rejection. Neighboring threat models has a different role: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想證明 15 ms、驗證 5 ms、秘密傳送 10 ms，串行初始化合 30 ms；若每秒 100 次初始作業且不可並行，每秒需 3 s 處理，單通道不足。
workedExample.textEn: Assumed attestation=15 ms, verification=5 ms and secret transfer=10 ms give 30 ms serial initialization; 100 starts/s require 3 processing-seconds/s, exceeding one serial channel.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 軟體弱點管理流程
summary: 以弱點風險、相依圖與修補放行串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 資產與風險
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「資產與風險」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop assets and risk through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資產識別：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資產識別」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for asset identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for asset identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
knowledge.textEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.

quiz.question: 審查「資產識別」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for asset identity?
options: 主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資產識別」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
optionsEn: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.
One matching output proves asset identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.
quiz.explanation: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 因此「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. The alternative "Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資產識別：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」；將結果與「同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Compare results against: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for asset identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
knowledge.textEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.

quiz.question: 審查「資產識別」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for asset identity?
options: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。
主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。
先把「資產識別」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory.
Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.
Tune the displayed asset identity result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 因此「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. The alternative "Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 軟體物料：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「軟體物料」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for software inventory.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「軟體物料」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：應用程式版本不能代表所有內含函式庫版本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較直接與傳遞相依的版本圖。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for software inventory. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Application versions do not identify every bundled dependency. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare direct and transitive dependency versions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較直接與傳遞相依的版本圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare direct and transitive dependency versions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只盤點最上層應用程式即可。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Inventorying only the top application is sufficient. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「軟體物料」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較直接與傳遞相依的版本圖。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for software inventory; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 應用程式版本不能代表所有內含函式庫版本。
knowledge.textEn: Application versions do not identify every bundled dependency.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較直接與傳遞相依的版本圖。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

應用程式版本不能代表所有內含函式庫版本。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「軟體物料」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Inventorying only the top application is sufficient.
Application versions do not identify every bundled dependency.
One matching output proves software inventory for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 應用程式版本不能代表所有內含函式庫版本。 比較直接與傳遞相依的版本圖。 因此「只盤點最上層應用程式即可。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Application versions do not identify every bundled dependency. Compare direct and transitive dependency versions. The alternative "Inventorying only the top application is sufficient." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對自製測試包核對雜湊與簽章信任根。」；將結果與「更新檔的完整性與供應者身分是不同檢查。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Check hashes and signature trust roots on a self-made package. Compare results against: Update integrity and publisher identity are distinct checks. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對自製測試包核對雜湊與簽章信任根。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Check hashes and signature trust roots on a self-made package. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：雜湊吻合便證明供應者可信。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A matching hash proves the publisher is trusted. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「供應來源」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「雜湊吻合便證明供應者可信。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for update provenance; explain why this claim fails: A matching hash proves the publisher is trusted.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 更新檔的完整性與供應者身分是不同檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Update integrity and publisher identity are distinct checks.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對自製測試包核對雜湊與簽章信任根。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Check hashes and signature trust roots on a self-made package. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「供應來源」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for update provenance?
options: 雜湊吻合便證明供應者可信。
先把「供應來源」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
對自製測試包核對雜湊與簽章信任根。
optionsEn: A matching hash proves the publisher is trusted.
Tune the displayed update provenance result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Check hashes and signature trust roots on a self-made package.
quiz.explanation: 更新檔的完整性與供應者身分是不同檢查。 對自製測試包核對雜湊與簽章信任根。 因此「雜湊吻合便證明供應者可信。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Update integrity and publisher identity are distinct checks. Check hashes and signature trust roots on a self-made package. The alternative "A matching hash proves the publisher is trusted." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 版本相依：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「版本相依」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for version dependencies.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「版本相依」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：修補一個元件可能使相依介面不相容。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for version dependencies. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Patching one component may break dependent interfaces. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Propagate a synthetic API change through dependencies. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Propagate a synthetic API change through dependencies. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：安全更新不可能改變功能介面。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Security updates cannot change interfaces. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「版本相依」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for version dependencies; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for version dependencies?
options: 修補一個元件可能使相依介面不相容。
安全更新不可能改變功能介面。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「版本相依」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。

Security updates cannot change interfaces.
One matching output proves version dependencies for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

knowledge.text: 用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct a failed batch and rollback decision offline. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.

quiz.question: 審查「復原回顧」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for recovery review?
options: 用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。
復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。
先把「復原回顧」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reconstruct a failed batch and rollback decision offline.
Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence.
Tune the displayed recovery review result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 故障原因、版本與驗收證據應可重建。 用離線時間線重現失敗批次與回退決策。 因此「復原成功表示不需保留失敗資料。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Causes, versions and acceptance evidence must be reconstructable. Reconstruct a failed batch and rollback decision offline. The alternative "Successful recovery removes the need to retain failure evidence." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
workedExample.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

title: 資安事件應變演練
summary: 以偵測、遏止與業務復原的協調串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect coordination of detection, containment and business recovery with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 準備與演練
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「準備與演練」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop preparation and exercises through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 授權範圍：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「授權範圍」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for exercise authority.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「授權範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for exercise authority. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有測試帳號都有正式系統處置權。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All test accounts have production-response authority. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「授權範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for exercise authority; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。
knowledge.textEn: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據

knowledge.textEn: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 12 起演練事件的偵測總時間 180 分鐘，平均 MTTD=15 分鐘；若一事件耗 90 分鐘，剩餘 11 起平均僅 8.18 分鐘。平均不能替代最慢事件與分位數，也不是服務保證。
knowledge.textEn: Twelve synthetic incidents detected over 180 minutes give mean MTTD=15 minutes. If one takes 90 minutes, the other eleven average 8.18 minutes. Report tails as well as means; these are not service guarantees.

quiz.question: 審查「授權範圍」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for exercise authority?
options: 演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。
所有測試帳號都有正式系統處置權。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「授權範圍」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises.
All test accounts have production-response authority.
One matching output proves exercise authority for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。 以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。 因此「所有測試帳號都有正式系統處置權。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. The alternative "All test accounts have production-response authority." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 授權範圍：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「授權範圍」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for exercise authority.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。」；將結果與「演練的系統、資料與處置許可權應事先確定。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Compare results against: Systems, data and response authority are defined before exercises. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以玩具環境寫出允許和禁止的處置。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify allowed and prohibited actions in a toy environment. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有測試帳號都有正式系統處置權。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All test accounts have production-response authority. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「授權範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有測試帳號都有正式系統處置權。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for exercise authority; explain why this claim fails: All test accounts have production-response authority.

steps.title: 證據可信：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「證據可信」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for evidence confidence.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「證據可信」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：來源、完整性與觀測缺口共同影響結論。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for evidence confidence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Provenance, integrity and blind spots affect conclusions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Duplicate logs are independent evidence. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「證據可信」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for evidence confidence; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 來源、完整性與觀測缺口共同影響結論。
knowledge.textEn: Provenance, integrity and blind spots affect conclusions.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「證據可信」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for evidence confidence?
options: 兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。
來源、完整性與觀測缺口共同影響結論。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「證據可信」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Duplicate logs are independent evidence.
Provenance, integrity and blind spots affect conclusions.
One matching output proves evidence confidence for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 來源、完整性與觀測缺口共同影響結論。 給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。 因此「兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Provenance, integrity and blind spots affect conclusions. Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. The alternative "Duplicate logs are independent evidence." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 證據可信：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「證據可信」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for evidence confidence.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。」；將結果與「來源、完整性與觀測缺口共同影響結論。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. Compare results against: Provenance, integrity and blind spots affect conclusions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Label confidence and gaps for synthetic observations. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Duplicate logs are independent evidence. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「證據可信」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for evidence confidence; explain why this claim fails: Duplicate logs are independent evidence.

quiz.question: 審查「證據可信」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for evidence confidence?
options: 兩條重複日誌便是兩個獨立證據。
先把「證據可信」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
給每項合成觀測標示可信度與缺口。
optionsEn: Duplicate logs are independent evidence.
Tune the displayed evidence confidence result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 競爭解釋：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「競爭解釋」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for competing hypotheses.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「競爭解釋」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：異常可能來自故障、變更或濫用。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為玩具登入尖峰提出兩個非攻擊解釋。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Anomalies may result from failures, changes or misuse. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Propose two nonattack explanations for a toy login spike. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

stages.title: 遏止與復原
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「遏止與復原」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 遏止代價：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「遏止代價」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「遏止代價」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：隔離能限制擴散但可能中斷關鍵依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for containment cost. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Isolation limits propagation but may break critical dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Predict isolation impact on an offline dependency graph. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Predict isolation impact on an offline dependency graph. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：隔離越多裝置業務損失必然越小。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「遏止代價」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Predict isolation impact on an offline dependency graph. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「遏止代價」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for containment cost?
options: 隔離越多裝置業務損失必然越小。
隔離能限制擴散但可能中斷關鍵依賴。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「遏止代價」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: More isolation necessarily reduces business loss.
Isolation limits propagation but may break critical dependencies.
One matching output proves containment cost for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 隔離能限制擴散但可能中斷關鍵依賴。 在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。 因此「隔離越多裝置業務損失必然越小。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 遏止代價：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「遏止代價」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for containment cost.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。」；將結果與「隔離能限制擴散但可能中斷關鍵依賴。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

title: 數位鑑識證據保全
summary: 以可追溯、完整且可重現的數位證據串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 授權與識別
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「授權與識別」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop authority and identification through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 合法與任務範圍：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Authority and scope: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「合法與任務範圍」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for authority and scope.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「合法與任務範圍」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for authority and scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：擁有技術能力就代表取得資料的授權。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Technical ability implies authority to obtain data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「合法與任務範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for authority and scope; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 一份假想 64 GiB 映像以 250 MiB/s 讀取，理想單次時間為 64×1024/250=262.14 秒；若採集後再完整驗證讀取一次，最低讀取時間約 524.29 秒。未含 I/O 競爭、寫入與工具開銷。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 64 GiB image read at 250 MiB/s takes 262.14 seconds ideally. One further full verification read brings minimum reading time to 524.29 seconds, excluding contention, writes and tool overhead.

quiz.question: 審查「合法與任務範圍」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for authority and scope?
options: 擁有技術能力就代表取得資料的授權。
證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「合法與任務範圍」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Technical ability implies authority to obtain data.
Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority.
One matching output proves authority and scope for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。 用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。 因此「擁有技術能力就代表取得資料的授權。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. The alternative "Technical ability implies authority to obtain data." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 合法與任務範圍：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Authority and scope: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「合法與任務範圍」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for authority and scope.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。」；將結果與「證據接觸需限定資料、目的與處理授權。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Compare results against: Evidence access is bounded by data, purpose and authority. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用自建測試檔描述可分析與不可分析區域。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Define analyzable areas on self-created test files. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：擁有技術能力就代表取得資料的授權。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Technical ability implies authority to obtain data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「合法與任務範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「擁有技術能力就代表取得資料的授權。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for authority and scope; explain why this claim fails: Technical ability implies authority to obtain data.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All data remains intact after shutdown. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

steps.title: 採集變更：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「採集變更」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: List logs and timestamps a toy collector may change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Read tools never change system state. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「採集變更」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「列出玩具工具可能產生的日誌與時間戳。」如何辨別它們。

steps.title: 唯讀路徑：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「唯讀路徑」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for read-only paths.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「唯讀路徑」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：寫入阻斷需涵蓋整個採集路徑而非單一設定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「只在本地副本上比較唯讀設定與寫入行為。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare read-only settings and writes on local copies only. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objective: 以「報告重現」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for report reproduction.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「報告重現」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：報告需列工具版本、輸入摘要與分析假設。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓另一位同學只依匿名報告重算結果。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for report reproduction. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reports specify tool versions, input digests and assumptions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce findings from an anonymous report. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓另一位同學只依匿名報告重算結果。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Screenshots alone fully reproduce analysis. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「報告重現」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓另一位同學只依匿名報告重算結果。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for report reproduction; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: 儲存與刪除：原理與架構

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「儲存與刪除」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：儲存期限、存取與合規要求需獨立管理。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for retention and deletion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retention, access and compliance requirements are managed separately. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify retention, expiry and exceptions in a fictional workflow. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「儲存與刪除」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在假想流程列出儲存、到期及例外批准。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.textEn: Specify retention, expiry and exceptions in a fictional workflow. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 一份假想 64 GiB 映像以 250 MiB/s 讀取，理想單次時間為 64×1024/250=262.14 秒；若採集後再完整驗證讀取一次，最低讀取時間約 524.29 秒。未含 I/O 競爭、寫入與工具開銷。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 64 GiB image read at 250 MiB/s takes 262.14 seconds ideally. One further full verification read brings minimum reading time to 524.29 seconds, excluding contention, writes and tool overhead.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
