title: 隱私保護資料分析
summary: 以資料最小化與隱私效用權衡串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data minimization and privacy–utility trade-offs with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 資料與目的
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「資料與目的」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop data and purpose through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 用途邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「用途邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for purpose boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「用途邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for purpose boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One consent permits every future purpose. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「用途邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for purpose boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。
knowledge.textEn: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 人平均收入分析先將收入界定於 0–100,000 單位；固定樣本數替換鄰接下，平均敏感度 Δ=100000/100=1000 單位。Laplace ε=1 時尺度 b=1000、標準差 √2b=1414.21 單位。只此假設成立時適用。
knowledge.textEn: For 100 synthetic people with values bounded to 0–100,000 units and fixed-size replace-one adjacency, mean sensitivity is 1,000 units. Laplace ε=1 gives b=1,000 and standard deviation 1,414.21 units; the assumptions are essential.

quiz.question: 審查「用途邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for purpose boundaries?
options: 取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「用途邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。
optionsEn: One consent permits every future purpose.
One matching output proves purpose boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes.
quiz.explanation: 同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 因此「取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. The alternative "One consent permits every future purpose." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 用途邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「用途邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for purpose boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」；將結果與「同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Compare results against: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One consent permits every future purpose. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「用途邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for purpose boundaries; explain why this claim fails: One consent permits every future purpose.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for purpose boundaries?
options: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for aggregation choices; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Single-person influence depends on bounds and adjacency.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 重算有界平均的替換敏感度。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate bounded-mean replace-one sensitivity. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「統計敏感度」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for statistical sensitivity?
options: 一人資料可使統計改變多少取決於界限與鄰接。
敏感度只取決於資料量，不依數值界限。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「統計敏感度」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Single-person influence depends on bounds and adjacency.
Sensitivity depends only on sample count.
One matching output proves statistical sensitivity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 一人資料可使統計改變多少取決於界限與鄰接。 重算有界平均的替換敏感度。 因此「敏感度只取決於資料量，不依數值界限。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Single-person influence depends on bounds and adjacency. Recalculate bounded-mean replace-one sensitivity. The alternative "Sensitivity depends only on sample count." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 統計敏感度：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「統計敏感度」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for statistical sensitivity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算有界平均的替換敏感度。」；將結果與「一人資料可使統計改變多少取決於界限與鄰接。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Recalculate bounded-mean replace-one sensitivity. Compare results against: Single-person influence depends on bounds and adjacency. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重算有界平均的替換敏感度。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate bounded-mean replace-one sensitivity. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：敏感度只取決於資料量，不依數值界限。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Sensitivity depends only on sample count. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「統計敏感度」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「敏感度只取決於資料量，不依數值界限。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for statistical sensitivity; explain why this claim fails: Sensitivity depends only on sample count.

steps.title: 噪聲與誤差：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Noise and error: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「噪聲與誤差」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for noise and error.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「噪聲與誤差」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：隨機保護會增加估計方差而非保證無偏於所有操作。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用合成抽樣比較發布前後誤差分佈。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for noise and error. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Randomized protection adds variance and does not guarantee every operation unbiased. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare error distributions with synthetic sampling. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用合成抽樣比較發布前後誤差分佈。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare error distributions with synthetic sampling. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加噪聲永遠不影響下游決策。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Adding noise never affects downstream decisions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「噪聲與誤差」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用合成抽樣比較發布前後誤差分佈。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for noise and error; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「小群組效用」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for small-group utility.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「小群組效用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：固定噪聲在小群組中有更大相對影響。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較同噪聲下 10 與 1000 人群組誤差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

steps.objective: 以「再現與稽核」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for reproduction and audit.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「再現與稽核」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：可重現分析需保留設定而不必散佈原始個資。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用合成替代資料重現指標計算。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for reproduction and audit. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproducibility needs settings without distributing personal data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用合成替代資料重現指標計算。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「再現與稽核」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用合成替代資料重現指標計算。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for reproduction and audit; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 可重現分析需保留設定而不必散佈原始個資。
knowledge.textEn: Reproducibility needs settings without distributing personal data.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用合成替代資料重現指標計算。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「再現與稽核」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for reproduction and audit?
options: 可重現分析需保留設定而不必散佈原始個資。
重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「再現與稽核」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Reproducibility needs settings without distributing personal data.
Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone.
One matching output proves reproduction and audit for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 可重現分析需保留設定而不必散佈原始個資。 用合成替代資料重現指標計算。 因此「重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Reproducibility needs settings without distributing personal data. Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. The alternative "Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 再現與稽核：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Reproduction and audit: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「再現與稽核」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for reproduction and audit.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用合成替代資料重現指標計算。」；將結果與「可重現分析需保留設定而不必散佈原始個資。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. Compare results against: Reproducibility needs settings without distributing personal data. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用合成替代資料重現指標計算。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Reproduce metric calculations using synthetic substitutes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「再現與稽核」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for reproduction and audit; explain why this claim fails: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone.

quiz.question: 審查「再現與稽核」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for reproduction and audit?
options: 重現必須向所有人公開原始個資。
用合成替代資料重現指標計算。
先把「再現與稽核」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reproduction requires sharing personal data with everyone.

Tune the displayed reproduction and audit result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 效用決策：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「效用決策」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for utility decisions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Privacy, error and purpose jointly define acceptable performance. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: State limits and unresolved risk for the example. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：選最小 ε 就必然得到最佳產品。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The smallest ε necessarily yields the best product. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「效用決策」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用本課算例寫出限用條件與未決風險。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 人平均收入分析先將收入界定於 0–100,000 單位；固定樣本數替換鄰接下，平均敏感度 Δ=100000/100=1000 單位。Laplace ε=1 時尺度 b=1000、標準差 √2b=1414.21 單位。只此假設成立時適用。
knowledge.textEn: For 100 synthetic people with values bounded to 0–100,000 units and fixed-size replace-one adjacency, mean sensitivity is 1,000 units. Laplace ε=1 gives b=1,000 and standard deviation 1,414.21 units; the assumptions are essential.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 假想 100 人平均收入分析先將收入界定於 0–100,000 單位；固定樣本數替換鄰接下，平均敏感度 Δ=100000/100=1000 單位。Laplace ε=1 時尺度 b=1000、標準差 √2b=1414.21 單位。只此假設成立時適用。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

title: 聯邦學習系統
summary: 以分散神經網路訓練、聚合與非同分佈資料串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect distributed neural training, aggregation and non-iid data with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 參與者與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「參與者與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop participants and data through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 聯邦邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「聯邦邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for federation boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「聯邦邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：資料留本地不表示梯度或模型不洩漏資訊。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫原始資料、更新與全域模型的流向。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for federation boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Local data retention does not prevent update or model leakage. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace raw data, updates and global-model flows. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫原始資料、更新與全域模型的流向。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Trace raw data, updates and global-model flows. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不傳原始資料就自動有差分隱私。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Not sending raw data automatically gives differential privacy. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「聯邦邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫原始資料、更新與全域模型的流向。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for federation boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 資料留本地不表示梯度或模型不洩漏資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Local data retention does not prevent update or model leakage.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫原始資料、更新與全域模型的流向。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Trace raw data, updates and global-model flows. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想三個客戶分別有 20、30、50 筆資料與標量更新 1、3、5；FedAvg 權重為 0.2、0.3、0.5，聚合更新為 3.6。等權平均為 3；權重差異反映樣本數而非品質保證，也未提供隱私保證。
knowledge.textEn: Three synthetic clients have 20, 30 and 50 samples and scalar updates 1, 3 and 5. Sample-weighted FedAvg yields 3.6; equal weighting yields 3. Weights reflect sample counts, not guaranteed quality or privacy.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫原始資料、更新與全域模型的流向。」；將結果與「資料留本地不表示梯度或模型不洩漏資訊。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for local backpropagation. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check one tiny-network gradient with finite differences. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objective: 以「本地反傳」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以有限差分核對小網路的一個權重梯度。」；將結果與「鏈式法則將本地損失梯度傳回每層參數。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「列出一個合成輪次所需的 DP 參數。」；將結果與「噪聲、裁剪、取樣與會計共同形成 DP 保證。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 列出一個合成輪次所需的 DP 參數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any added noise justifies a formal DP claim. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「差分隱私」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只加任意噪聲便可宣佈正式 DP。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for differential privacy; explain why this claim fails: Any added noise justifies a formal DP claim.

stages.title: 評估與交付
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「評估與交付」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 模型驗證：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「模型驗證」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for model validation.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「模型驗證」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：全域與每客戶測試需避免資料重疊。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「建立合成客戶隔離與時間隔離測試。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for model validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Global and client tests must avoid overlapping training data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build client-isolated and time-isolated synthetic tests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 建立合成客戶隔離與時間隔離測試。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Build client-isolated and time-isolated synthetic tests. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：各客戶訓練集就是可靠的全域測試。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Client training sets are reliable global tests. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「模型驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「建立合成客戶隔離與時間隔離測試。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for model validation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。」；將結果與「一筆紀錄與一位使用者可能不是同一鄰接單位。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Compare results against: A record and a person may be different adjacency units. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Record-level DP automatically equals user-level DP. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「保護單位」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for protected units; explain why this claim fails: Record-level DP automatically equals user-level DP.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 教學計數的加減一鄰接敏感度為 1；ε=0.5 的 Laplace 尺度 b=2，標準差 √8=2.828。五次各 ε=0.5 查詢用基本序列組合得 ε_total≤2.5；共享固定發布的後處理不另消耗預算。
knowledge.textEn: An add/remove-one count has sensitivity 1. At ε=0.5, Laplace b=2 and standard deviation is 2.828. Basic composition bounds five ε=0.5 releases by total ε≤2.5; post-processing one fixed release spends no additional budget.

quiz.question: 審查「保護單位」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for protected units?
options: 紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。
先把「保護單位」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。
optionsEn: Record-level DP automatically equals user-level DP.
Tune the displayed protected units result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person.
quiz.explanation: 一筆紀錄與一位使用者可能不是同一鄰接單位。 比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。 因此「紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

Principle: Replace-one and add/remove-one adjacency can differ in sensitivity. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate both adjacency differences on a small table. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「鄰接選擇」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以小資料表計算兩種鄰接下的差異。」如何辨別它們。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for gaussian mechanism. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Gaussian calibration needs epsilon, delta and sensitivity. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare calibrated methods only under stated assumptions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 僅比較已列假設的校準方法與適用區間。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare calibrated methods only under stated assumptions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.check: 提交「Gaussian 機制」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「僅比較已列假設的校準方法與適用區間。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for gaussian mechanism; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

Gaussian calibration needs epsilon, delta and sensitivity.
One matching output proves gaussian mechanism for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

steps.title: Gaussian 機制：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「Gaussian 機制」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「僅比較已列假設的校準方法與適用區間。」；將結果與「Gaussian 噪聲校準需同時考慮 ε、δ 與敏感度。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.title: 加法路徑：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare hypothetical same-level and different-level operations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observation: 比較 toy sigmoid 近似在範圍內外的誤差。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare toy sigmoid approximation inside and outside its range. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：逼近在一點準確便對所有輸入準確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Accuracy at one point implies accuracy everywhere. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「多項式近似」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「逼近在一點準確便對所有輸入準確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for polynomial approximations; explain why this claim fails: Accuracy at one point implies accuracy everywhere.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Arrange short vectors and check per-slot results. title: 安全多方計算系統

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for preprocessing material. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Multiplication triples must match protocol security assumptions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark offline material and online consumption symbolically. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Mark offline material and online consumption symbolically. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

optionsEn: One multiplication triple can be reused indefinitely.

steps.objective: 以「預處理材料」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以符號流程標示離線材料和線上使用。」；將結果與「乘法三元組等材料必須與協議安全假設相容。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.check: 提交「預處理材料」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同一個三元組可以無限重用。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for preprocessing material; explain why this claim fails: One multiplication triple can be reused indefinitely.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare totals, means and individual-input outputs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: 節點身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「節點身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for node identity.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for node identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Entity identity is stored separately from display names. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「節點身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。」如何辨別它們。

steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for uniqueness constraints.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「注入不同鍵但同實體的玩具重複資料。」；將結果與「唯一鍵能限制重複但不能保證語意正確。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Insert toy duplicates with different keys but one entity. Compare results against: Unique keys limit duplication without ensuring semantic truth. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 注入不同鍵但同實體的玩具重複資料。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Insert toy duplicates with different keys but one entity. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：唯一約束消除所有實體辨識錯誤。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Uniqueness constraints eliminate all entity-resolution errors. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「唯一約束」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「唯一約束消除所有實體辨識錯誤。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for uniqueness constraints; explain why this claim fails: Uniqueness constraints eliminate all entity-resolution errors.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 唯一鍵能限制重複但不能保證語意正確。
knowledge.textEn: Unique keys limit duplication without ensuring semantic truth.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 注入不同鍵但同實體的玩具重複資料。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Insert toy duplicates with different keys but one entity. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「唯一約束」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for uniqueness constraints?
options: 唯一約束消除所有實體辨識錯誤。
注入不同鍵但同實體的玩具重複資料。
先把「唯一約束」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Uniqueness constraints eliminate all entity-resolution errors.
Insert toy duplicates with different keys but one entity.
Tune the displayed uniqueness constraints result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 唯一鍵能限制重複但不能保證語意正確。 注入不同鍵但同實體的玩具重複資料。 因此「唯一約束消除所有實體辨識錯誤。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Unique keys limit duplication without ensuring semantic truth. Insert toy duplicates with different keys but one entity. The alternative "Uniqueness constraints eliminate all entity-resolution errors." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 索引入口：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Index entry points: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「索引入口」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for index entry points.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「索引入口」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：索引加速起始候選集合而非每條遍歷。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較小圖的全掃描與索引查詢計畫。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for index entry points. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Indexes accelerate starting candidates, not every traversal. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare scans and index seeks on a small graph. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較小圖的全掃描與索引查詢計畫。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare scans and index seeks on a small graph. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：建立任何索引都會加速所有查詢。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any index speeds every query. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「索引入口」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較小圖的全掃描與索引查詢計畫。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for index entry points; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Indexes accelerate starting candidates, not every traversal.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較小圖的全掃描與索引查詢計畫。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare scans and index seeks on a small graph. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「索引入口」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for index entry points?
options: 建立任何索引都會加速所有查詢。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「索引入口」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
索引加速起始候選集合而非每條遍歷。
optionsEn: Any index speeds every query.
One matching output proves index entry points for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Indexes accelerate starting candidates, not every traversal.
quiz.explanation: 索引加速起始候選集合而非每條遍歷。 比較小圖的全掃描與索引查詢計畫。 因此「建立任何索引都會加速所有查詢。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Indexes accelerate starting candidates, not every traversal. Compare scans and index seeks on a small graph. The alternative "Any index speeds every query." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 基數估計：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「基數估計」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for cardinality estimates.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for cardinality estimates. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Skewed degree distributions can defeat average-degree estimates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare candidate counts in uniform and hub graphs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較均勻圖與樞紐圖的候選數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare candidate counts in uniform and hub graphs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均節點度數足以描述最差展開。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Average degree describes worst-case expansion. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「基數估計」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較均勻圖與樞紐圖的候選數。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.textEn: Skewed degree distributions can defeat average-degree estimates.

knowledge.text: 比較均勻圖與樞紐圖的候選數。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

圖形分佈偏斜會讓平均度數估計失準。

One matching output proves cardinality estimates for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

quiz.explanationEn: Skewed degree distributions can defeat average-degree estimates. Compare candidate counts in uniform and hub graphs. The alternative "Average degree describes worst-case expansion." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare bounded and unbounded expansion on a small cycle. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.textEn: Have a peer reconstruct an engineering chain from sources. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想平均出度 b=4 的無重複樹狀圖，深度 3 搜尋最多檢查 1+4+16+64=85 個節點。實際圖含環、共享節點與過濾，因此此幾何級數只是展開上界模型，不能當作資料庫耗時預測。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic tree with branching factor 4 searched to depth 3 visits 1+4+16+64=85 nodes. Real graphs have cycles, shared nodes and filters; this geometric model is not a database runtime prediction.

quiz.question: 審查「交付圖譜」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for graph delivery?
options: 圖形畫得漂亮就證明知識正確。

讓同學依來源重建一條工程關係鏈。
optionsEn: Attractive visualization proves correct knowledge.
Tune the displayed graph delivery result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Have a peer reconstruct an engineering chain from sources.
quiz.explanation: 圖譜驗收需同時看資料品質與查詢正確性。 讓同學依來源重建一條工程關係鏈。 因此「圖形畫得漂亮就證明知識正確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

title: 搜尋引擎索引與排序
summary: 以倒排索引、詞項評分與搜尋品質串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect inverted indexes, term scoring and search quality with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 文字與索引
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「文字與索引」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop text and indexes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 檔案身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「檔案身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for document identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「檔案身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for document identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：URL 不變表示內容永不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An unchanged URL implies unchanged content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「檔案身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for document identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「檔案身分」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for document identity?
options: URL 不變表示內容永不變。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「檔案身分」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。
optionsEn: An unchanged URL implies unchanged content.
One matching output proves document identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins.
quiz.explanation: 索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。 把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。 因此「URL 不變表示內容永不變。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins. Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. The alternative "An unchanged URL implies unchanged content." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 檔案身分：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「檔案身分」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for document identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」；將結果與「索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Compare results against: Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：URL 不變表示內容永不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An unchanged URL implies unchanged content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「檔案身分」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「URL 不變表示內容永不變。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for document identity; explain why this claim fails: An unchanged URL implies unchanged content.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for inverse document frequency. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rare-term discrimination depends on corpus statistics. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate IDF with different document frequencies. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「逆檔案頻率」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課 IDF 並更換檔案頻數。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for inverse document frequency; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

A term in every document best distinguishes documents.

steps.titleEn: Inverse document frequency: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「逆檔案頻率」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課 IDF 並更換檔案頻數。」；將結果與「罕見詞的區分能力由語料統計決定。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for source usability. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.check: 提交「來源可用」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for source usability; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。
knowledge.textEn: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想問題有 10 個相關切片，top-5 取回 3 個；precision@5=3/5=0.6，recall@5=3/10=0.3。若答案引用 4 個可核驗宣告中 3 個獲來源支援，宣告支援率=0.75；此率不是整體答案正確率。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic query has 10 relevant chunks; top five retrieve three, giving precision@5=0.6 and recall@5=0.3. Three supported claims among four verifiable claims give support rate 0.75, not overall answer accuracy.

quiz.question: 審查「來源可用」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for source usability?
options: 來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。
找到公開 PDF 就可全文重製。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「來源可用」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations.
Finding a public PDF permits full reproduction.
One matching output proves source usability for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。 為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。 因此「找到公開 PDF 就可全文重製。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. The alternative "Finding a public PDF permits full reproduction." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 來源可用：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「來源可用」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for source usability.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。」；將結果與「來源需有版本、授權與可引用位置。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual. Compare results against: Sources need versions, rights and citeable locations. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 為自製手冊建立來源 ID 與段落位址。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw dual-encoder and cross-encoder computation paths. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: 提示信任：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「提示信任」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for prompt trust.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for prompt trust. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Source content is data, not automatically system authority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：檔案裡的指示都應優先於系統規則。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Document instructions override system rules. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「提示信任」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for prompt trust; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「參數與啟用」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for parameters and activations.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫單請求與多請求的記憶體共享範圍。」；將結果與「權重、啟用與快取有不同生命週期。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.check: 提交「參數與啟用」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「模型檔案大小就是總記憶體需求。」為何不成立。

steps.title: 詞元表示：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「詞元表示」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for token representations.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「詞元表示」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：token 化影響序列長度與語言成本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for token representations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tokenization affects sequence length and language costs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare token counts of self-made Chinese, English and formulas. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare token counts of self-made Chinese, English and formulas. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：同字數不同語言必然同 token 數。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal character counts imply equal token counts across languages. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「詞元表示」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for token representations; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「前饋層」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：逐 token 非線性變換可主導參數與運算量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for feed-forward layers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Per-token nonlinear transformations can dominate parameters and compute. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate dimensions of a toy d-to-4d-to-d block. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate dimensions of a toy d-to-4d-to-d block. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Transformers contain only attention and no nonlinearity. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「前饋層」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for feed-forward layers; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「前饋層」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「計算玩具 d×4d×d 兩層矩陣維度。」；將結果與「逐 token 非線性變換可主導參數與運算量。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較玩具量化前後層輸出與誤差。」；將結果與「低位權重減少容量但可能改變輸出與數值誤差。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare layer outputs before and after toy quantization. Compare results against: Low-bit weights reduce size but may alter outputs and error. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具量化前後層輸出與誤差。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare layer outputs before and after toy quantization. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：四位權重在所有題目都與 FP16 完全相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Four-bit weights always equal FP16 outputs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「量化誤差」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「四位權重在所有題目都與 FP16 完全相同。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for quantization errors; explain why this claim fails: Four-bit weights always equal FP16 outputs.

Four-bit weights always equal FP16 outputs.

stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「驗證與交付」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 連續批次：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「連續批次」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for continuous batching.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「連續批次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：動態合批提高利用率但需處理請求生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬短長請求加入退出的排程表。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for continuous batching. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Dynamic batching improves utilization while tracking request lifecycles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate short and long request arrivals and exits. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 模擬短長請求加入退出的排程表。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Simulate short and long request arrivals and exits. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：合批越大每個請求延遲必然越低。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Larger batches always lower every request’s latency. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「連續批次」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「模擬短長請求加入退出的排程表。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for continuous batching; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for continuous batching?
options: 合批越大每個請求延遲必然越低。
動態合批提高利用率但需處理請求生命週期。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「連續批次」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。

knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」；將結果與「資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Compare results against: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal folder names imply equal content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料身分」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal folder names imply equal content.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。
knowledge.textEn: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

quiz.question: 審查「資料身分」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for data identity?
options: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。
資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。
先把「資料身分」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table.
Equal folder names imply equal content.
Tune the displayed data identity result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 因此「資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. The alternative "Equal folder names imply equal content." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 內容摘要：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「內容摘要」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for content digests.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「內容摘要」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：摘要辨別內容變化但不證明標註質量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for content digests. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Digests distinguish changes without proving label quality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Change one synthetic row and compare digests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Change one synthetic row and compare digests. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：雜湊正確代表每個標註正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Correct hashes prove every label correct. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「內容摘要」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for content digests; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: 程式碼資料分離：原理與架構

steps.check: 提交「程式碼資料分離」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具 Git metadata 與資料物件對應。」如何辨別它們。

steps.title: 快取與去重：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Caching and deduplication: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「快取與去重」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for caching and deduplication.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課理想儲存並標記不能共享部分。」；將結果與「內容重用可減少複製但需驗證物件完整性。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.title: 失效重算：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Propagate one parameter change through a toy graph. steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在玩具圖傳播一個參數變更。」；將結果與「輸入或參數變化需重算受影響的後續階段。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.check: 提交「失效重算」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只改參數不需重算任何產物。」為何不成立。

steps.title: 血緣記錄：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Model versions link actual inputs, parameters and code. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Produce a complete lineage digest for a toy model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for lineage records; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「找出玩具保留策略下會失效的版本。」；將結果與「刪除物件會破壞引用它的歷史版本。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Identify revisions broken by a toy retention policy. Compare results against: Deleting objects can break historical revisions referencing them. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 找出玩具保留策略下會失效的版本。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Identify revisions broken by a toy retention policy. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：刪除舊資料不影響任何舊模型重現。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Deleting old data never affects old-model reproduction. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「留存策略」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「刪除舊資料不影響任何舊模型重現。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retention policies; explain why this claim fails: Deleting old data never affects old-model reproduction.

knowledge.text: 刪除物件會破壞引用它的歷史版本。

optionsEn: Deleting old data never affects old-model reproduction.
Identify revisions broken by a toy retention policy.

steps.title: 交付驗收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「交付驗收」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for delivery acceptance.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「交付驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交付需驗證內容、執行與授權三種完整性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for delivery acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Delivery checks content, execution and rights integrity. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unzipping proves research reproducibility. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交付驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems

title: 模型監測與漂移偵測
summary: 以資料漂移、品質與模型效能分離串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect separation of data drift, quality and model performance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 基準與資料

knowledge.textEn: Build versions for self-made monitoring data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想基準 N(0,1) 與執行 N(0.5,1)，均值偏移為 0.5 個基準標準差。兩批各 n=100 時均值差標準誤 sqrt(1/100+1/100)=0.1414，z≈3.536；此理想檢驗假設獨立常態且不是效能下降證明。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic reference N(0,1) and current N(0.5,1) differ by 0.5 reference deviations. Two independent n=100 batches give mean-difference SE=0.1414 and z≈3.536 under normal assumptions; drift is not proof of performance loss.

quiz.question: 審查「基準版本」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for reference versions?
options: 最新資料總是最佳且唯一基準。
建立自製監測資料的版本表。
先把「基準版本」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: The latest data is always the sole best reference.
Build versions for self-made monitoring data.
Tune the displayed reference versions result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 比較需固定基準資料、時間窗與模型版本。 建立自製監測資料的版本表。 因此「最新資料總是最佳且唯一基準。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparisons pin reference data, windows and model versions. Build versions for self-made monitoring data. The alternative "The latest data is always the sole best reference." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料品質：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料品質」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data quality.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料品質」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data quality. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every data anomaly is concept drift. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料品質」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data quality; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。
knowledge.textEn: Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「資料品質」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data quality?
options: 所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料品質」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。
optionsEn: Every data anomaly is concept drift.
One matching output proves data quality for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift.
quiz.explanation: 缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。 因此「所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift. Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. The alternative "Every data anomaly is concept drift." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料品質：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料品質」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data quality.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。」；將結果與「缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. Compare results against: Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every data anomaly is concept drift. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料品質」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data quality; explain why this claim fails: Every data anomaly is concept drift.

steps.title: 均值檢驗：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「均值檢驗」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

Principle: Mean tests depend on count, variance and independence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate z and change sample counts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重算本課 z 值並改變樣本數量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate z and change sample counts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：均值差相同就有相同統計顯著度。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal mean differences imply equal significance. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「均值檢驗」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課 z 值並改變樣本數量。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for mean tests; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
