steps.title: 監測驗收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「監測驗收」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for monitoring acceptance.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「監測驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：驗收需檢驗漏報、誤報與實際行動價值。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用自製固定題集比較兩種監測策略。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two monitoring policies on self-made fixed cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 驗收需檢驗漏報、誤報與實際行動價值。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance tests misses, false alarms and action value.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據

knowledge.textEn: Compare two monitoring policies on self-made fixed cases. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想基準 N(0,1) 與執行 N(0.5,1)，均值偏移為 0.5 個基準標準差。兩批各 n=100 時均值差標準誤 sqrt(1/100+1/100)=0.1414，z≈3.536；此理想檢驗假設獨立常態且不是效能下降證明。

steps.observationEn: Compare two monitoring policies on self-made fixed cases. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More alerts mean more effective monitoring. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「監測驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「告警越多就表示監測越有效。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for monitoring acceptance; explain why this claim fails: More alerts mean more effective monitoring.

title: 向量資料庫相似度搜尋
summary: 以向量距離、近似索引與召回成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具向量 x=(3,4)、y=(4,3)，範數皆為 5，餘弦相似度=24/25=0.96，Euclidean 距離=√2≈1.414。單位向量距離平方=2(1−cos)=0.08；未正規化時此式不能直接沿用。
knowledge.textEn: Toy x=(3,4), y=(4,3) both have norm 5, cosine 0.96 and Euclidean distance sqrt(2). For normalized vectors, squared distance is 2(1−cos)=0.08; the identity cannot be applied unchanged to unnormalized inputs.

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「同意與範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。」如何辨別它們。

steps.title: CTC 對齊：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「CTC 對齊」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for ctc alignment.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for ctc alignment. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: CTC merges repeats and removes blanks to form text. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 手算兩條含 blank 的玩具標籤路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：CTC 的 blank 就是普通空白字元。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: CTC blank is an ordinary space character. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「CTC 對齊」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手算兩條含 blank 的玩具標籤路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for ctc alignment; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

summary: 以影像物理、卷積架構與檢測誤差串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。

stages.title: 成像與標定
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「成像與標定」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 光學取樣：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「光學取樣」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for optical sampling.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「光學取樣」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：畫素、視野和鏡頭共同決定可辨尺寸。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對假想視野計算毫米每畫素。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for optical sampling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Pixels, field of view and lenses set resolvable sizes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate millimeters per pixel for an assumed field. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對假想視野計算毫米每畫素。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate millimeters per pixel for an assumed field. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.check: 提交「光學取樣」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對假想視野計算毫米每畫素。」如何辨別它們。

steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for annotation granularity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「標註粒度」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分類、框和分割標註具有不同目標。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for annotation granularity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Classes, boxes and masks target different tasks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create three annotation types for self-made parts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Create three annotation types for self-made parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：類別標籤自動提供準確缺陷邊界。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Class labels automatically provide precise boundaries. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「標註粒度」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for annotation granularity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 分類、框和分割標註具有不同目標。
knowledge.textEn: Classes, boxes and masks target different tasks.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Create three annotation types for self-made parts. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「標註粒度」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for annotation granularity?
options: 類別標籤自動提供準確缺陷邊界。
分類、框和分割標註具有不同目標。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「標註粒度」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Class labels automatically provide precise boundaries.
Classes, boxes and masks target different tasks.
One matching output proves annotation granularity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 分類、框和分割標註具有不同目標。 對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。 因此「類別標籤自動提供準確缺陷邊界。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Classes, boxes and masks target different tasks. Create three annotation types for self-made parts. The alternative "Class labels automatically provide precise boundaries." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 標註粒度：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「標註粒度」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for annotation granularity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。」；將結果與「分類、框和分割標註具有不同目標。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Create three annotation types for self-made parts. Compare results against: Classes, boxes and masks target different tasks. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對自製零件圖分別製作三種標註。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Create three annotation types for self-made parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：類別標籤自動提供準確缺陷邊界。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Class labels automatically provide precise boundaries. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「標註粒度」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「類別標籤自動提供準確缺陷邊界。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for annotation granularity; explain why this claim fails: Class labels automatically provide precise boundaries.

steps.title: 卷積參數：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Stride alone does not change parameter count. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate example shapes, parameters and MACs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「卷積參數」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課卷積尺寸、參數與 MAC。」如何辨別它們。

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 玩具卷積輸入 32×32×3，核 3×3、stride1、padding1、輸出 16 通道：輸出 32×32×16；權重 3×3×3×16=432，加偏置為 448 參數；直接卷積約 32×32×16×27=442368 MAC，1 MAC 是否算 2 FLOP 必須宣告。
workedExample.textEn: A toy 32×32×3 input with 3×3 kernels, stride 1, padding 1 and 16 outputs gives 32×32×16 activations, 448 parameters including biases and 442,368 MACs. Declare whether one MAC is counted as two FLOPs.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems

title: 工業數位分身資料平台
summary: 以物理狀態、事件資料與分身一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect physical state, event data and twin consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 實體與語意
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實體與語意」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop entities and semantics through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 實體標識：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「實體標識」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for entity identifiers.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「實體標識」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for entity identifiers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「實體標識」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for entity identifiers; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想溫度感測器每秒 10 次、每筆 40 bytes，1000 個感測器原始資料率=400000 bytes/s，約 0.4 MB/s；一天 34.56 GB 十進位。訊息封裝、索引、副本和重送不在此值內。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic fleet of 1,000 sensors at 10 samples/s and 40 bytes/sample produces 400,000 bytes/s or 34.56 decimal GB/day, before message framing, indexes, replication and retries.

steps.title: 測量單位：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「測量單位」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。」；將結果與「單位、座標與時間基準是資料語意的一部分。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.title: 時間版本：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate late data and latest-state updates. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The latest arrival always represents the latest physical state. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時間版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for temporal versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for reported and desired state?
options: 寫入期望狀態就表示裝置已到達。

steps.title: 狀態與期望：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Reported and desired state: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「狀態與期望」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for reported and desired state.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具裝置設定與回報差異曲線。」；將結果與「實際回報與期望設定不能直接混同。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Plot desired/reported differences for a toy device. Compare results against: Reported and desired states are not interchangeable. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫玩具裝置設定與回報差異曲線。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Plot desired/reported differences for a toy device. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：寫入期望狀態就表示裝置已到達。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Writing desired state means the device has reached it. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「狀態與期望」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「寫入期望狀態就表示裝置已到達。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for reported and desired state; explain why this claim fails: Writing desired state means the device has reached it.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for reported and desired state?
options: 畫玩具裝置設定與回報差異曲線。
寫入期望狀態就表示裝置已到達。

steps.title: 流量預算：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「流量預算」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for traffic budgets.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「流量預算」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：取樣頻率、記錄大小與數量決定原始資料率。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課資料率與一天容量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for traffic budgets. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rate, record size and device count set raw traffic. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate example traffic and daily capacity. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重算本課資料率與一天容量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate example traffic and daily capacity. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原始資料率已經包含所有副本與索引。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Raw traffic includes all replicas and indexes. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「流量預算」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課資料率與一天容量。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for traffic budgets; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「預測告警」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用假想殘差比較正常偏移與故障假設。」；將結果與「異常閾值需結合模型誤差與行動目的。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for boundary clipping; explain why this claim fails: Individually correct tiles guarantee seamless joins.

steps.title: 細節層次：原理與架構

steps.objective: 以「細節層次」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for levels of detail. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Geometry simplification trades size against topology. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare crossings before and after toy curve simplification. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Compare crossings before and after toy curve simplification. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Removing vertices never changes topology. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「細節層次」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具曲線簡化前後交叉關係。」如何辨別它們。

options: 併發與視窗移動會產生取消和重複請求。
所有移出視窗請求都必須繼續下載。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「請求併發」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Concurrency and viewport movement create cancellations and duplicates.
All offscreen requests must continue downloading.
One matching output proves request concurrency for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 併發與視窗移動會產生取消和重複請求。 以玩具請求表比較取消與繼續傳輸。 因此「所有移出視窗請求都必須繼續下載。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Concurrency and viewport movement create cancellations and duplicates. Compare cancellation and continued transfers in a toy table. The alternative "All offscreen requests must continue downloading." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 請求併發：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「請求併發」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for request concurrency.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以玩具請求表比較取消與繼續傳輸。」；將結果與「併發與視窗移動會產生取消和重複請求。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare cancellation and continued transfers in a toy table. Compare results against: Concurrency and viewport movement create cancellations and duplicates. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以玩具請求表比較取消與繼續傳輸。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare cancellation and continued transfers in a toy table. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有移出視窗請求都必須繼續下載。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All offscreen requests must continue downloading. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「請求併發」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有移出視窗請求都必須繼續下載。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for request concurrency; explain why this claim fails: All offscreen requests must continue downloading.

steps.title: 空間索引：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「空間索引」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for spatial indexes.

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Bounding-box indexes filter candidates, not exact intersections. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw overlapping boxes whose geometries do not intersect. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫兩項包圍盒重疊但幾何不交的例。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Bounding-box intersection proves geometry intersection. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「空間索引」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫兩項包圍盒重疊但幾何不交的例。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for spatial indexes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Vertex stages transform attributes for rasterization. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace self-made triangle vertices to screen. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare depth quantization with toy clip planes. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objective: 以「深度判斷」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for depth testing; explain why this claim fails: Wider depth ranges never affect precision.

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫計算寫紋理與圖形讀紋理的屏障。」；將結果與「同步還需讓寫入對後續讀取可見。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均 FPS 完全描述所有卡頓。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for frame-time decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Average FPS describes every stutter.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。

title: 科學高效能計算排程

knowledge.text: 假想作業用 8 節點、每節點 32 core、執行 2 小時，計量為 16 node-hours 與 512 core-hours。若 40% 時間等待通訊，不可直接說有效工作只有 307.2 core-hours；等待也佔分配資源，利用率需額外量測。
knowledge.textEn: An eight-node, 32-core/node job running two hours consumes 16 node-hours and 512 core-hours. Communication waiting still occupies allocated resources; measured utilization cannot be inferred merely by subtracting wait fractions.

steps.title: 優先序：原理與架構

steps.observationEn: Compare scheduling rules for three toy jobs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.check: 提交「優先序」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用三個玩具作業比較不同排序規則。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for priority; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

提交最早者在所有政策下一定先執行。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「優先序」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Age, quotas and policy jointly set priority.
The earliest submission always runs first.
One matching output proves priority for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

quiz.explanationEn: Age, quotas and policy jointly set priority. Compare scheduling rules for three toy jobs. The alternative "The earliest submission always runs first." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 優先序：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「優先序」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for priority.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用三個玩具作業比較不同排序規則。」；將結果與「年齡、配額與政策共同決定排序。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare scheduling rules for three toy jobs. Compare results against: Age, quotas and policy jointly set priority. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. steps.check: 提交「優先序」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「提交最早者在所有政策下一定先執行。」為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare neighboring and scattered toy nodes. Compare results against: Network distance can affect communication cost. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具近鄰與分散節點配置。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點數量相同就通訊成本完全相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal node counts imply equal communication costs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「拓撲分配」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「節點數量相同就通訊成本完全相同。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for topology allocation; explain why this claim fails: Equal node counts imply equal communication costs.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two preemptions for a hypothetical checkpointed job. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「可搶佔性」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對假想 checkpoint 作業比較兩次搶佔。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for preemptibility; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「任務繫結」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for task binding. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Binding processes and threads to CPU cores/NUMA nodes affects sharing and memory locality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. knowledge.textEn: Compilers, libraries and inputs are pinned for reproduction.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 輸出玩具環境版本與輸入摘要。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Record toy environment versions and input digests. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「環境版本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for environment versions?
options: 指令碼相同就保證所有版本結果相同。
編譯器、庫與輸入必須固定以重現。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「環境版本」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Equal scripts guarantee equal results across versions.
Compilers, libraries and inputs are pinned for reproduction.
One matching output proves environment versions for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 編譯器、庫與輸入必須固定以重現。 輸出玩具環境版本與輸入摘要。 因此「指令碼相同就保證所有版本結果相同。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Compilers, libraries and inputs are pinned for reproduction. Record toy environment versions and input digests. The alternative "Equal scripts guarantee equal results across versions." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 環境版本：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「環境版本」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for environment versions.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「輸出玩具環境版本與輸入摘要。」；將結果與「編譯器、庫與輸入必須固定以重現。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Record toy environment versions and input digests. Compare results against: Compilers, libraries and inputs are pinned for reproduction. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 輸出玩具環境版本與輸入摘要。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record toy environment versions and input digests. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：指令碼相同就保證所有版本結果相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal scripts guarantee equal results across versions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「環境版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「指令碼相同就保證所有版本結果相同。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for environment versions; explain why this claim fails: Equal scripts guarantee equal results across versions.

steps.title: 輸出儲存：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「輸出儲存」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for output persistence.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「輸出儲存」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：計算節點暫存不等於長期產物儲存。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具作業結束後資料遷移路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for output persistence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Node temporary storage is not durable artifact storage. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data persistence after a toy job ends. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具作業結束後資料遷移路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw data persistence after a toy job ends. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：程式成功退出即保證輸出永遠存在。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Successful exit guarantees permanent outputs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「輸出儲存」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具作業結束後資料遷移路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for output persistence; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「排隊時間」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「交付驗證」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：科學交付需包含結果、環境與資源證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學重算一個本地小作業。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for delivery validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Scientific delivery includes results, environments and resource evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce one small local job. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同學重算一個本地小作業。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer reproduce one small local job. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：擁有超算賬號就是正確科學結果證明。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A supercomputer account proves correct science. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交付驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學重算一個本地小作業。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for delivery validation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 科學交付需包含結果、環境與資源證據。
knowledge.textEn: Scientific delivery includes results, environments and resource evidence.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 讓同學重算一個本地小作業。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Have a peer reproduce one small local job. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想作業用 8 節點、每節點 32 core、執行 2 小時，計量為 16 node-hours 與 512 core-hours。若 40% 時間等待通訊，不可直接說有效工作只有 307.2 core-hours；等待也佔分配資源，利用率需額外量測。
knowledge.textEn: An eight-node, 32-core/node job running two hours consumes 16 node-hours and 512 core-hours. Communication waiting still occupies allocated resources; measured utilization cannot be inferred merely by subtracting wait fractions.

quiz.question: 審查「交付驗證」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for delivery validation?
options: 擁有超算賬號就是正確科學結果證明。
科學交付需包含結果、環境與資源證據。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「交付驗證」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: A supercomputer account proves correct science.
Scientific delivery includes results, environments and resource evidence.
One matching output proves delivery validation for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 科學交付需包含結果、環境與資源證據。 讓同學重算一個本地小作業。 因此「擁有超算賬號就是正確科學結果證明。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Scientific delivery includes results, environments and resource evidence. Have a peer reproduce one small local job. The alternative "A supercomputer account proves correct science." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 交付驗證：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「交付驗證」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for delivery validation.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「讓同學重算一個本地小作業。」；將結果與「科學交付需包含結果、環境與資源證據。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Have a peer reproduce one small local job. Compare results against: Scientific delivery includes results, environments and resource evidence. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 讓同學重算一個本地小作業。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer reproduce one small local job. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：擁有超算賬號就是正確科學結果證明。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A supercomputer account proves correct science. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交付驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「擁有超算賬號就是正確科學結果證明。」為何不成立。

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。

workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。

steps.title: 程序與執行緒：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Processes and threads: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「程序與執行緒」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for processes and threads.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「程序與執行緒」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：MPI rank 與執行緒在地址空間與通訊上不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫兩 rank 各兩執行緒的資料所有權。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: Communicator：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Communicator」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for communicators.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「Communicator」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for communicators. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ranks never change across communicators. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Communicator」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for communicators; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.check: 提交「halo 交換」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手算玩具 stencil 有無 halo 的誤差。」如何辨別它們。

steps.objective: 以「halo 交換」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「手算玩具 stencil 有無 halo 的誤差。」；將結果與「鄰接資料讓區域性 stencil 正確讀取邊界。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。」；將結果與「背景和觀測誤差協方差決定融合權重。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Calculate one-dimensional fusion for two variances. Compare results against: Background and observation covariance determine fusion weights. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate one-dimensional fusion for two variances. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最接近當前均值的觀測必然權重最大。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The observation nearest the current mean always has greatest weight. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「誤差權重」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「最接近當前均值的觀測必然權重最大。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for error weighting; explain why this claim fails: The observation nearest the current mean always has greatest weight.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 背景和觀測誤差協方差決定融合權重。
knowledge.textEn: Background and observation covariance determine fusion weights.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate one-dimensional fusion for two variances. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「誤差權重」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for error weighting?
options: 手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。
最接近當前均值的觀測必然權重最大。
先把「誤差權重」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Calculate one-dimensional fusion for two variances.
The observation nearest the current mean always has greatest weight.
Tune the displayed error weighting result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

stages.title: 計算與集合
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「計算與集合」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop computing and ensembles through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 參數化耦合：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「參數化耦合」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for parameterization coupling.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「參數化耦合」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：輻射、雲與地表交換互相影響。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具能量收支的耦合方向。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for parameterization coupling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Radiation, clouds and surface exchange interact. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw couplings in a toy energy budget. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具能量收支的耦合方向。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw couplings in a toy energy budget. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：各參數化可獨立改變且不影響其他過程。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Parameterizations change independently without interactions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「參數化耦合」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具能量收支的耦合方向。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for parameterization coupling; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「參數化耦合」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Parameterizations change independently without interactions.
Radiation, clouds and surface exchange interact.
One matching output proves parameterization coupling for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.textEn: For a toy explicit 1D advection scheme with speed 20 m/s and spacing 1,000 m, CFL≤0.8 gives dt≤40 s. Halving spacing gives dt≤20 s at the same CFL; this does not represent operational IFS settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算

title: CERN 全球 LHC 運算網格
summary: 以分層科學資料處理與跨機構計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect tiered scientific processing and interinstitutional computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 實驗與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實驗與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop experiments and data through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 科學鏈路：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「科學鏈路」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for scientific chains.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「科學鏈路」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific chains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「科學鏈路」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。

knowledge.text: 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 PB 十進位資料需經穩定 10 Gbit/s 鏈路傳輸，理想下限 10¹⁵×8/10¹⁰=800000 s，約 9.26 天。協議、排隊、故障與複製會增加時間；不代表 WLCG 實際資料率。
knowledge.textEn: One synthetic decimal PB over a sustained 10-Gbit/s link has ideal minimum 800,000 s or 9.26 days. Protocols, queues, failures and replication add time; this is not an actual WLCG data rate.

Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts.
One matching output proves scientific chains for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「公開邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。
optionsEn: Scientific collaboration makes all data public.
One matching output proves public boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions.
quiz.explanation: 開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。 因此「科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions. Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. The alternative "Scientific collaboration makes all data public." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 公開邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「公開邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for public boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。」；將結果與「開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. Compare results against: Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Scientific collaboration makes all data public. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「公開邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for public boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Scientific collaboration makes all data public.

steps.title: 探測器校正：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「探測器校正」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for detector calibration.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「探測器校正」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：重建輸出依賴校正與條件資料。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for detector calibration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reconstruction depends on calibration and conditions data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one toy event under two calibrations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare one toy event under two calibrations. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原始資料不變就保證重建結果不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unchanged raw data guarantees unchanged reconstruction. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「探測器校正」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for detector calibration; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 512-bit SVE 向量可容納 8 個 FP64 元素；若一指令為向量 FMA，每元素算乘加2 FLOP，則每指令 16 FLOP。48 核、2 GHz 且假想每週期僅一條 FMA 給 1.536 TFLOP/s；不能當實際峰值，因為發射能力需另查。
knowledge.textEn: A 512-bit SVE vector holds eight FP64 elements; one vector FMA counts 16 FLOPs under a two-operation convention. Forty-eight cores at 2 GHz with an assumed one FMA/cycle give 1.536 TFLOP/s, not an actual peak without issue-capability details.

knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the example’s one-FMA-per-cycle assumption. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「FMA 計數」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for fma accounting?
options: FMA 峰值需說明精度、向量寬度與發射數。
FMA 計數不需說明一 MAC 是否為兩 FLOP。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「FMA 計數」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: FMA peaks state precision, width and issue count.
FMA counting needs no operation convention.
One matching output proves fma accounting for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: FMA 峰值需說明精度、向量寬度與發射數。 重算本課假想每週期一條 FMA。 因此「FMA 計數不需說明一 MAC 是否為兩 FLOP。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: FMA peaks state precision, width and issue count. Recalculate the example’s one-FMA-per-cycle assumption. The alternative "FMA counting needs no operation convention." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: FMA 計數：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「FMA 計數」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for fma accounting.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課假想每週期一條 FMA。」；將結果與「FMA 峰值需說明精度、向量寬度與發射數。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Recalculate the example’s one-FMA-per-cycle assumption. Compare results against: FMA peaks state precision, width and issue count. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重算本課假想每週期一條 FMA。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate the example’s one-FMA-per-cycle assumption. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FMA 計數不需說明一 MAC 是否為兩 FLOP。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: FMA counting needs no operation convention. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「FMA 計數」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「FMA 計數不需說明一 MAC 是否為兩 FLOP。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for fma accounting; explain why this claim fails: FMA counting needs no operation convention.

stages.title: 記憶體與核心
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「記憶體與核心」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop memory and cores through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 核心群組：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「核心群組」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for core-memory groups.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「核心群組」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：CMG 把核心與近端記憶體分組形成局部性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具四群組的陣列分塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for core-memory groups. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: CMGs group cores and nearby memory for locality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw toy array partitions across four groups. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具四群組的陣列分塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw toy array partitions across four groups. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：同節點所有記憶體路徑必然完全相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every same-node memory path is identical. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「核心群組」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具四群組的陣列分塊。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for core-memory groups; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 歷史 Summit 計算節點有 6 個 V100 GPU；假想每 GPU 一份 12 GiB 工作集，總為 72 GiB，但分散的裝置記憶體不能自動成為單一連續 72 GiB 陣列。若每輪主機裝置搬移 1 GB、50 GB/s 假想持續速率，單向下限 20 ms。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「節點分工」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：每個 Summit 計算節點的雙 POWER9 與六 V100 有不同職責；登入節點的配置不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把玩具預處理與矩陣核心分到兩側。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Principle: Two POWER9 CPUs and six V100 GPUs have distinct roles in each Summit compute node; login-node configurations differ. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Place toy preprocessing and matrix kernels by role. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「節點分工」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「六 GPU 自動意味著六倍任何應用速度。」為何不成立。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a toy matrix across six devices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「多 GPU 劃分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把玩具矩陣按塊分給六裝置。」如何辨別它們。

options: 比較兩份合成報告的精度與任務邊界。
歷史系統峰值能直接預測新平臺速度。
先把「效能比較」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Compare precision and scope in two synthetic reports.
Historical peaks directly predict new-platform speed.
Tune the displayed performance comparisons result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 歷史峰值、實測與未來移植不得混為一談。 比較兩份合成報告的精度與任務邊界。 因此「歷史系統峰值能直接預測新平臺速度。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Historical peaks, measurements and future ports are distinct. Compare precision and scope in two synthetic reports. The alternative "Historical peaks directly predict new-platform speed." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 科學複核：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「科學複核」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for scientific review.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「科學複核」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：重現需留任務定義與誤差，而非只留平臺名。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學用本地小題重算科學約束。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific review. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproduction retains tasks and errors, not just platform names. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer check scientific constraints on a small local task. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同學用本地小題重算科學約束。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer check scientific constraints on a small local task. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：使用 Summit 字樣即證明原算例來自實測。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific review; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 歷史 Summit 計算節點有 6 個 V100 GPU；假想每 GPU 一份 12 GiB 工作集，總為 72 GiB，但分散的裝置記憶體不能自動成為單一連續 72 GiB 陣列。若每輪主機裝置搬移 1 GB、50 GB/s 假想持續速率，單向下限 20 ms。

Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The name Summit proves example values measured there. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「科學複核」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「使用 Summit 字樣即證明原算例來自實測。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific review; explain why this claim fails: The name Summit proves example values measured there.

title: LUMI 超級電腦架構
summary: 以LUMI 的 CPU/GPU 分割槽與高頻寬計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect lumi cpu/gpu partitions and high-bandwidth computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 任務與分割槽

steps.title: 分割槽目的：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「分割槽目的」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

knowledge.text: 假想 4096³ 個 FP64 格點單陣列為 549755813888 bytes，即 512 GiB；若每邏輯 GPU 假想能分配 50 GiB，至少需 ceil(512/50)=11 個裝置，只算單陣列。halo、第二緩衝與庫工作空間將提高需求，不能當實際 LUMI 配額。

steps.title: 容量規劃：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate the 512-GiB example and minimum devices. knowledge.textEn: Access bytes include reads, writes and repeated reads.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 為玩具 stencil 列完整 bytes/FLOP。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: List complete bytes per FLOP for a toy stencil. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「頻寬核算」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for bandwidth accounting?
options: 為玩具 stencil 列完整 bytes/FLOP。
只計算輸出 bytes 就是全部頻寬需求。
先把「頻寬核算」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: List complete bytes per FLOP for a toy stencil.
Output bytes equal all bandwidth requirements.
Tune the displayed bandwidth accounting result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 訪問位元組應包含讀、寫及重複讀取。 為玩具 stencil 列完整 bytes/FLOP。 因此「只計算輸出 bytes 就是全部頻寬需求。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Access bytes include reads, writes and repeated reads. List complete bytes per FLOP for a toy stencil. The alternative "Output bytes equal all bandwidth requirements." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料重用：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料重用」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data reuse.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料重用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：快取與共享儲存可改變實際外部流量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data reuse. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Caches and shared storage can change external traffic. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare repeated reads before and after toy tiling. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare repeated reads before and after toy tiling. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每次程式讀取都必然訪問 HBM。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every program read necessarily reaches HBM. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料重用」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data reuse; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

quiz.question: 審查「資料重用」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data reuse?
options: 每次程式讀取都必然訪問 HBM。
快取與共享儲存可改變實際外部流量。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料重用」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Every program read necessarily reaches HBM.
Caches and shared storage can change external traffic.
One matching output proves data reuse for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 快取與共享儲存可改變實際外部流量。 比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。 因此「每次程式讀取都必然訪問 HBM。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Caches and shared storage can change external traffic. Compare repeated reads before and after toy tiling. The alternative "Every program read necessarily reaches HBM." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料重用：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料重用」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data reuse.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。」；將結果與「快取與共享儲存可改變實際外部流量。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare repeated reads before and after toy tiling. Compare results against: Caches and shared storage can change external traffic. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具 tile 前後重複讀取量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare repeated reads before and after toy tiling. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每次程式讀取都必然訪問 HBM。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every program read necessarily reaches HBM. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料重用」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每次程式讀取都必然訪問 HBM。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data reuse; explain why this claim fails: Every program read necessarily reaches HBM.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 4096³ 個 FP64 格點單陣列為 549755813888 bytes，即 512 GiB；若每邏輯 GPU 假想能分配 50 GiB，至少需 ceil(512/50)=11 個裝置，只算單陣列。halo、第二緩衝與庫工作空間將提高需求，不能當實際 LUMI 配額。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 4096-cubed FP64 array is 512 GiB. At assumed usable 50 GiB/logical GPU it needs at least 11 devices for one array only. Halos, extra buffers and library workspaces add capacity; this is not a LUMI quota.

平臺名不取代版本、輸入與可重算結果。
optionsEn: Completing this course means operating real LUMI.
One matching output proves scientific delivery for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Platform names do not replace versions, inputs and reproducible results.

title: Aurora 超級電腦架構
summary: 以Aurora 的 Xeon Max、Ponte Vecchio 與資料路徑串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect aurora xeon max, ponte vecchio and data paths with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 系統與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「系統與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop systems and nodes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 異質節點：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「異質節點」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for heterogeneous nodes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「異質節點」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous nodes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質節點」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for heterogeneous nodes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 公開架構有每節點 6 GPU；假想 1024³ FP64 陣列為 8 GiB，若每 GPU 存同樣輸入加兩個輸出共 24 GiB，則六份複製需 144 GiB，分佈分塊未必需六份輸入。例子是容量模型，非 Aurora 實際應用。

Exercise: Compare resource budgets for toy workgroups. Compare results against: Registers and shared local memory constrain concurrency. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具 workgroup 的資源預算。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Larger workgroups are always faster. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「工作組資源」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「workgroup 越大必然越快。」為何不成立。

workgroup 越大必然越快。

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。

title: ARPANET 歷史網路架構
summary: 以封包交換、分層協議與歷史遷移串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect packet switching, layered protocols and historical transitions with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 歷史與需求
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與需求」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and needs through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 歷史證據：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「歷史證據」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for historical evidence.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「歷史證據」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：歷史回顧與當年協議檔案提供不同證據層次。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把公開事件按出處與日期分列。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for historical evidence. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate public events by source and date. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把公開事件按出處與日期分列。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate public events by source and date. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：今日協議可原樣代表所有早期網路。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Current protocols represent all early networks unchanged. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史證據」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把公開事件按出處與日期分列。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for historical evidence; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 50 kbit/s 鏈路傳送 1000 bytes，序列化時間 8000/50000=0.16 s。若儲存轉發經三條同速鏈路、不重疊且每段傳播20 ms，單包總下限=3×(160+20)=540 ms；未含排隊，不代表 ARPANET 的實測時延。
knowledge.textEn: A toy 50-kbit/s link serializes 1,000 bytes in 160 ms. Three same-speed store-and-forward links with 20-ms propagation each and no overlap give 540 ms for one packet before queuing; not an ARPANET measurement.

One matching output proves historical evidence for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
