options: 存在替代路徑就保證立即恢復且零丟包。
在紙上小圖刪除一邊尋找替代路。
先把「路由與故障」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: An alternate path guarantees immediate loss-free recovery.
Remove a link in a paper graph and find alternatives.
Tune the displayed routing and failure result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 路徑選擇需處理斷路與資料陳舊。 在紙上小圖刪除一邊尋找替代路。 因此「存在替代路徑就保證立即恢復且零丟包。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Route selection handles failed links and stale state. Remove a link in a paper graph and find alternatives. The alternative "An alternate path guarantees immediate loss-free recovery." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

stages.title: 協議與遷移
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「協議與遷移」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop protocols and transitions through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 確認與重送：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Acknowledgment and retry: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「確認與重送」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for acknowledgment and retry.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「確認與重送」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：超時與確認判斷丟失但可能產生重複。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for acknowledgment and retry. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Timeouts and acknowledgments infer loss but can duplicate packets. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重送只會產生一次有效訊息。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Retries always produce exactly one effective message. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「確認與重送」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for acknowledgment and retry; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 超時與確認判斷丟失但可能產生重複。
knowledge.textEn: Timeouts and acknowledgments infer loss but can duplicate packets.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「確認與重送」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for acknowledgment and retry?
options: 重送只會產生一次有效訊息。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「確認與重送」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
超時與確認判斷丟失但可能產生重複。
optionsEn: Retries always produce exactly one effective message.
One matching output proves acknowledgment and retry for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Timeouts and acknowledgments infer loss but can duplicate packets.
quiz.explanation: 超時與確認判斷丟失但可能產生重複。 模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。 因此「重送只會產生一次有效訊息。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Timeouts and acknowledgments infer loss but can duplicate packets. Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. The alternative "Retries always produce exactly one effective message." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 確認與重送：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Acknowledgment and retry: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「確認與重送」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for acknowledgment and retry.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。」；將結果與「超時與確認判斷丟失但可能產生重複。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. Compare results against: Timeouts and acknowledgments infer loss but can duplicate packets. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 模擬自製訊息確認遺失的情境。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Simulate a lost acknowledgment for self-made messages. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重送只會產生一次有效訊息。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Retries always produce exactly one effective message. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「確認與重送」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「重送只會產生一次有效訊息。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for acknowledgment and retry; explain why this claim fails: Retries always produce exactly one effective message.

workedExample.textEn: A toy 50-kbit/s link serializes 1,000 bytes in 160 ms. Three same-speed store-and-forward links with 20-ms propagation each and no overlap give 540 ms for one packet before queuing; not an ARPANET measurement.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

title: 全球資訊網早期伺服器系統
titleEn: Early World Wide Web server systems
summary: 以超文字、HTTP 與早期科學資訊共享串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect hypertext, http and early scientific information sharing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 歷史與檔案
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與檔案」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and documents through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 歷史角色：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「歷史角色」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for historical roles.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「歷史角色」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：CERN 的 Web 起源包含資訊共享需求與實現。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for historical roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: CERN Web origins combine information-sharing needs and implementations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Web 與 Internet 都在同一天以同一用途誕生。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Web and Internet arose on one day for one purpose. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史角色」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for historical roles; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: CERN 的 Web 起源包含資訊共享需求與實現。
knowledge.textEn: CERN Web origins combine information-sharing needs and implementations.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 20 kB HTML 加 3 張各40 kB 圖片總為 140 kB；在持續 100 kB/s 下資料傳輸下限1.4 s。若序列每物件另有0.1 s 等待，四物件總至少1.8 s，未含解析、DNS與重送；不代表首個 Web 伺服器。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 20-kB HTML file plus three 40-kB images totals 140 kB. Sustained 100 kB/s gives 1.4-s transfer minimum; four sequential 0.1-s waits make 1.8 s before parsing, DNS and retries, not the first Web server’s performance.

quiz.question: 審查「歷史角色」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for historical roles?
options: Web 與 Internet 都在同一天以同一用途誕生。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「歷史角色」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
CERN 的 Web 起源包含資訊共享需求與實現。
optionsEn: Web and Internet arose on one day for one purpose.
One matching output proves historical roles for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
CERN Web origins combine information-sharing needs and implementations.
quiz.explanation: CERN 的 Web 起源包含資訊共享需求與實現。 整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。 因此「Web 與 Internet 都在同一天以同一用途誕生。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: CERN Web origins combine information-sharing needs and implementations. Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. The alternative "Web and Internet arose on one day for one purpose." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 歷史角色：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「歷史角色」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for historical roles.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。」；將結果與「CERN 的 Web 起源包含資訊共享需求與實現。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. Compare results against: CERN Web origins combine information-sharing needs and implementations. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 整理公開1989提案與1990實現的層次。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate public 1989 proposal and 1990 implementation contexts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Web 與 Internet 都在同一天以同一用途誕生。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Web and Internet arose on one day for one purpose. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史角色」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「Web 與 Internet 都在同一天以同一用途誕生。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for historical roles; explain why this claim fails: Web and Internet arose on one day for one purpose.

optionsEn: Attractive screens guarantee access for everyone.

Have a peer browse three self-made pages without a mouse.

steps.title: 來源與授權：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Sources and rights: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「來源與授權」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「來源與授權」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：引用歷史連結不授予複製原圖全文。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「使用自製頁面並列官方延伸連結。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for sources and rights. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Historical links do not grant figure or full-text reuse. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Use self-made pages with official extension links. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 使用自製頁面並列官方延伸連結。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Use self-made pages with official extension links. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Public historical pages allow unlimited reproduction. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「來源與授權」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「使用自製頁面並列官方延伸連結。」如何辨別它們。

scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。

title: Linux 作業系統協作工程
summary: 以核心協作、併發機制與版本驗證串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。

steps.objective: 以「架構差異」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for architecture differences.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用玩具 byte 陣列比較兩種解讀。」；將結果與「位元組序、對齊與原子語意依平臺而異。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.check: 提交「架構差異」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「一平臺可用就保證所有架構正確。」為何不成立。

title: Internet 根網域伺服器系統

summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect dns delegation, anycast and root-service resilience with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

steps.check: 提交「根角色」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具根、TLD 與權威三層查詢。」如何辨別它們。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a toy trust chain without configuring real zones. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

options: DNSSEC 會讓所有查詢名稱不可見。
簽章認證來源與完整性，不加密查詢名稱。

Signatures authenticate provenance/integrity, not query secrecy.

steps.title: DNSSEC 信任：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「DNSSEC 信任」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for dnssec trust.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具信任鏈而不設定真實區檔。」；將結果與「簽章認證來源與完整性，不加密查詢名稱。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. steps.check: 提交「DNSSEC 信任」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「DNSSEC 會讓所有查詢名稱不可見。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for dnssec trust; explain why this claim fails: DNSSEC hides every queried name.

knowledge.textEn: Simulate route changes on a paper city map. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「任播路徑」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for anycast paths?
options: 在紙上多城市圖模擬路徑變化。
anycast 表示每次請求同時送到所有節點。
先把「任播路徑」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Simulate route changes on a paper city map.
Anycast sends each request to every node.
Tune the displayed anycast paths result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 同一地址可由多處服務，由路由選路徑。 在紙上多城市圖模擬路徑變化。 因此「anycast 表示每次請求同時送到所有節點。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: One address may be served in many locations selected by routing. Simulate route changes on a paper city map. The alternative "Anycast sends each request to every node." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 故障域：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「故障域」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for failure domains.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「故障域」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：營運者、地點、路由與軟體形成不同故障域。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for failure domains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Operators, sites, routes and software create different failure domains. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark shared suppliers and paths in a fictional deployment. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark shared suppliers and paths in a fictional deployment. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同城市就完全沒有共同故障域。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Different cities guarantee no shared failure domain. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「故障域」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for failure domains; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「故障域」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for failure domains?
options: 不同城市就完全沒有共同故障域。
營運者、地點、路由與軟體形成不同故障域。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「故障域」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Different cities guarantee no shared failure domain.
Operators, sites, routes and software create different failure domains.
One matching output proves failure domains for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 營運者、地點、路由與軟體形成不同故障域。 對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。 因此「不同城市就完全沒有共同故障域。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 故障域：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「故障域」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for failure domains.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。」；將結果與「營運者、地點、路由與軟體形成不同故障域。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Mark shared suppliers and paths in a fictional deployment. Compare results against: Operators, sites, routes and software create different failure domains. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對假想部署標共同供應與路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark shared suppliers and paths in a fictional deployment. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同城市就完全沒有共同故障域。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Different cities guarantee no shared failure domain. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「故障域」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「不同城市就完全沒有共同故障域。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for failure domains; explain why this claim fails: Different cities guarantee no shared failure domain.

steps.title: 查詢最小化：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「查詢最小化」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for query minimization.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「查詢最小化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分層查詢可減少每層收到的完整名稱資訊。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具逐層所需標籤範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for query minimization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Layered queries can reduce full-name disclosure at each layer. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw required labels at each toy layer. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Root resolution requires every full application URL. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「查詢最小化」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具逐層所需標籤範圍。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for query minimization; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy cold- and warm-cache timings. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在IBM Heron 超導量子處理器案例中比較transmon 能階與Heron 耦合圖，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate transmon levels and heron coupling graph within the IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor case.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對transmon 能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for transmon levels.
steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交transmon 能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for transmon levels.

knowledge.title: 超導電路與非諧性
knowledge.text: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 本課架構對應：transmon 能階
knowledge.textEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Course architecture correspondence: Transmon levels

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 30 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^30=0.970431。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 30 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^30=0.970431. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。

optionsEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

quiz.explanationEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.

steps.instruction: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Willow 非諧能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for willow anharmonic levels.
steps.instruction: 在「Google Willow 表面碼系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Willow 非諧能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify willow anharmonic levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google Willow surface-code system. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for willow anharmonic levels.

knowledge.title: 超導電路與非諧性

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 33 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0011 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^33=0.964332。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 33 independent events with equal p=0.0011: no-error probability (1−p)^33=0.964332. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

quiz.question: 就Willow 非諧能階的「超導電路與非諧性」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for superconducting circuits and anharmonicity in willow anharmonic levels?
options: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。
所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels.
Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。
quiz.explanationEn: Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage.

steps.title: 超導電路與非諧性：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Superconducting circuits and anharmonicity: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Willow 非諧能階提出可反駁的超導電路與非諧性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model and evidence record for willow anharmonic levels.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「超導電路與非諧性」模型，檢查Willow 非諧能階的兩個假想案例。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous superconducting circuits and anharmonicity model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving willow anharmonic levels. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有諧振器都天然等同隔離良好的二能階位元。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every oscillator naturally forms an isolated two-level qubit.
steps.check: 提交Willow 非諧能階的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for willow anharmonic levels.

steps.title: 耦合圖與路由：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Coupling graphs and routing: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對表面碼鄰接圖提出可反駁的耦合圖與路由模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable coupling graphs and routing model and evidence record for surface-code adjacency.
steps.instruction: 在「Google Willow 表面碼系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識表面碼鄰接圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify surface-code adjacency in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google Willow surface-code system. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。
steps.observationEn: Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物理位元數相同就代表相同電路成本。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal physical-qubit counts imply equal circuit costs.
steps.check: 提交表面碼鄰接圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for surface-code adjacency.

steps.objective: 針對同時閘串擾提出可反駁的微波控制與串擾模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「Google Willow 表面碼系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識同時閘串擾。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識熱化與環境屏蔽。每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。 建立低溫熱路與訊號負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 低溫熱路與訊號負載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogenic heat paths and signal loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對熱化與環境屏蔽提出可反駁的低溫熱路與訊號負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cryogenic heat paths and signal loads model and evidence record for thermalization and shielding.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「低溫熱路與訊號負載」模型，檢查熱化與環境屏蔽的兩個假想案例。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous cryogenic heat paths and signal loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving thermalization and shielding. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。
steps.observationEn: Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：室溫機櫃功耗等於稀釋冷凍機最低溫熱負載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Room-temperature rack power equals the coldest-stage thermal load.
steps.check: 提交熱化與環境屏蔽的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for thermalization and shielding.

steps.title: 錯誤更正與邏輯證據：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Error correction and logical evidence: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對閘誤差與邏輯證據提出可反駁的錯誤更正與邏輯證據模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable error correction and logical evidence model and evidence record for gate errors and logical evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識閘誤差與邏輯證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gate errors and logical evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture. Logical and physical error rates differ; threshold behavior requires comparisons across code distances under controlled conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of error correction and logical evidence, focusing on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。
steps.observationEn: Compare logical error per cycle and confidence intervals across code distances.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加物理位元必然降低邏輯錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More physical qubits necessarily reduce logical error.
steps.check: 提交閘誤差與邏輯證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gate errors and logical evidence.

summary: 以方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯解析Rigetti Ankaa-3 方格量子架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Rigetti Ankaa-3 square-lattice architecture through square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

steps.title: 離子陷阱與模態：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ion traps and modes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Yb離子與集體模態提出可反駁的離子陷阱與模態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ion traps and modes model and evidence record for yb ions and collective modes.
steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Yb離子與集體模態。電場侷限帶電離子；集體運動模態提供部分糾纏閘的中介。 建立離子陷阱與模態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify yb ions and collective modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對跑道QCCD搬運提出可反駁的離子搬運與分區模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Identify racetrack qccd transport in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. QCCD connects zones by transport; rearrangement time and heating contribute to circuit cost. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion transport and zoning, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw a two-zone transport graph and separate gates, transport and cooling. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Quantinuum H2 QCCD 離子架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識中途螢光量測。讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。 建立螢光讀出與重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是跑道陷阱、分區搬運及中途量測。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mid-circuit fluorescence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Quantinuum H2 QCCD ion architecture. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.

steps.title: 離子陷阱與模態：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Forte離子鏈模態。電場侷限帶電離子；集體運動模態提供部分糾纏閘的中介。 建立離子陷阱與模態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify forte ion-chain modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Electric fields confine charged ions; collective motion mediates some entangling gates. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ion traps and modes, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate internal states, motional modes and environmental noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 區分內部態、運動模態及環境噪聲三個子系統。

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for forte ion-chain modes.

steps.title: 運動介導的糾纏：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識激光糾纏與閉合軌跡。兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 建立運動介導的糾纏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. knowledge.textEn: Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information. Course architecture correspondence: Laser entanglement and closed paths

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.

quiz.question: 就激光糾纏與閉合軌跡的「運動介導的糾纏」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for motion-mediated entanglement in laser entanglement and closed paths?
options: 只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。
兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.
Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。

steps.title: 運動介導的糾纏：證據驗證
steps.objective: 針對激光糾纏與閉合軌跡提出可反駁的運動介導的糾纏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable motion-mediated entanglement model and evidence record for laser entanglement and closed paths.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「運動介導的糾纏」模型，檢查激光糾纏與閉合軌跡的兩個假想案例。比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分兩離子控制需在閘結束後避免殘留態與運動糾纏，否則動作資訊成為噪聲。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous motion-mediated entanglement model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving laser entanglement and closed paths. Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Entangling control should avoid residual state-motion entanglement after a gate, or motion retains error-producing information." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較閉合與未閉合假想相空間軌跡。
steps.observationEn: Compare closed and unclosed hypothetical phase-space paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要任意時刻有糾纏就代表閘完成。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Entanglement at any intermediate time proves a completed gate.
steps.check: 提交激光糾纏與閉合軌跡的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for laser entanglement and closed paths.

steps.title: 連通性與排程：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對全連通與共享光路提出可反駁的連通性與排程模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable connectivity and scheduling model and evidence record for connectivity and shared optics.
steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識全連通與共享光路。邏輯全連通不保證所有閘能同時執行；光學通道與模態共享形成排程限制。 建立連通性與排程的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify connectivity and shared optics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Logical all-to-all connectivity does not imply unlimited parallel gates; shared optical channels and modes constrain scheduling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of connectivity and scheduling, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對相同閘集合比較串行及資源受限排程。
steps.observationEn: Compare serial and resource-limited schedules for the same gate set.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：全連通等同零延遲及無限並行。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All-to-all connectivity means zero latency and unlimited parallelism.
steps.check: 提交全連通與共享光路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for connectivity and shared optics.

steps.title: 線性鏈與QCCD比較：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Linear chains versus QCCD: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對重排與通道邊界提出可反駁的線性鏈與QCCD比較模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable linear chains versus qccd model and evidence record for rearrangement and channel boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識重排與通道邊界。Forte公開架構重點為光學可設定離子鏈；QCCD搬運是可比較的另一架構，不宣稱Forte實作跑道QCCD。 建立線性鏈與QCCD比較的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。並排比較位址重設與離子搬運，標出各自公開支持的功能。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify rearrangement and channel boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Forte emphasizes optically configurable ion chains; QCCD transport is a contrasting architecture, not a claim that Forte implements a racetrack QCCD. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear chains versus qccd, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare addressing reconfiguration/ion transport and label publicly supported functions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 並排比較位址重設與離子搬運，標出各自公開支持的功能。
steps.observationEn: Compare addressing reconfiguration/ion transport and label publicly supported functions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Forte使用離子就必然採用H2的跑道搬運。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Using ions means Forte necessarily has H2 racetrack transport.
steps.check: 提交重排與通道邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for rearrangement and channel boundaries.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable fluorescence readout and reuse model and evidence record for fluorescence and sample distributions.
steps.instruction: 在「IonQ Forte 光學位址量子核心」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識螢光與樣本分佈。讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。 建立螢光讀出與重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是聲光偏轉選址與線性離子鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify fluorescence and sample distributions in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IonQ Forte optically addressed quantum core. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on acousto-optic addressing and linear ion chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。
steps.observationEn: Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.
steps.check: 提交螢光與樣本分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fluorescence and sample distributions.

knowledge.title: 螢光讀出與重用
knowledge.text: 讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。 本課架構對應：螢光與樣本分佈
knowledge.textEn: Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Course architecture correspondence: Fluorescence and sample distributions

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較兩個計數分佈的指派錯誤並記錄讀出時窗。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assignment errors for two count distributions and record the readout window. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 42 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0010 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^42=0.958850。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 42 independent events with equal p=0.0010: no-error probability (1−p)^42=0.958850. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

quiz.question: 就螢光與樣本分佈的「螢光讀出與重用」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for fluorescence readout and reuse in fluorescence and sample distributions?
options: 較多光子必然改善整個電路且沒有反作用。
讀出由散射光子統計決定；重置、旁觀者位元及量測時間影響中途量測。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: More photons always improve the full circuit without back-action.
Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.objective: 針對Aquila光鑷佔位提出可反駁的光鑷陣列與裝載模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Aquila光鑷佔位。中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 建立光鑷陣列與裝載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify aquila tweezer occupancy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical-tweezer arrays and loading, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。

steps.title: Rydberg 阻塞與距離：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Rydberg blockade and distance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Rydberg距離耦合提出可反駁的Rydberg 阻塞與距離模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable rydberg blockade and distance model and evidence record for rydberg distance coupling.
steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Rydberg距離耦合。Rydberg 相互作用對原子距離敏感；常見模型以 C6/r6 描述兩體位移。 建立Rydberg 阻塞與距離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify rydberg distance coupling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of rydberg blockade and distance, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 類比哈密頓量：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對類比驅動與失諧提出可反駁的類比哈密頓量模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「QuEra Aquila 中性原子類比機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識類比驅動與失諧。驅動、失諧與幾何共同定義時間相依模型；類比演化不等於任意數位閘電路。 建立類比哈密頓量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可重排幾何與 Rydberg 多體類比模擬。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用小系統矩陣重算本徵值與控制參數變化。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Drive, detuning and geometry define a time-dependent model; analog evolution is not an arbitrary digital circuit. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of analog hamiltonians, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識時間相依哈密頓量。驅動、失諧與幾何共同定義時間相依模型；類比演化不等於任意數位閘電路。 建立類比哈密頓量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用小系統矩陣重算本徵值與控制參數變化。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of analog hamiltonians, focusing on device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Pulser序列約束。控制序列受通道、時間與位址能力限制；模擬器允許的序列未必可上硬體。 建立脈衝與硬體限制的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將一段假想序列逐欄核對公開裝置約束。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識有限樣本關聯函數。關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。 建立關聯函數與有限樣本的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Path, time-bin and continuous-variable encodings use different observables; modes are not universal qubit counts. steps.objective: 針對PNR與homodyne量測提出可反駁的PNR與homodyne分工模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable pnr and homodyne roles model and evidence record for pnr/homodyne measurement.
steps.instruction: 在「Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識PNR與homodyne量測。PNR光子數量測用於條件資源與多工；homodyne觀測光場quadrature，不能當成同一計數量測。 建立PNR與homodyne分工的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。並排標示計數標籤、quadrature與各自的校正及雜訊基準。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of quantum dots and spin subspaces, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.objective: 針對自旋共振選擇提出可反駁的自旋控制與共振模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spin control and resonance model and evidence record for spin-resonance selectivity.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自旋共振選擇。能階分裂設定共振尺度；控制選擇性仍受漂移與鄰近頻率限制。 建立自旋控制與共振的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩個假想頻率分佈的可分辨性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spin control and resonance, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare resolvability of two assumed frequency distributions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識低溫控制熱預算。近端電子降低接線需求但增加局部發熱；需要按低溫層分配功耗。 建立低溫電子與能耗的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把控制功耗與每層散熱裕度分開。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate controller power from cooling margins per stage. title: D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理

steps.title: Ising 與 QUBO 對映：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Ising and QUBO mapping: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對QUBO與Ising符號提出可反駁的Ising 與 QUBO 對映模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ising and qubo mapping model and evidence record for qubo and ising signs.
steps.instruction: 在「D-Wave Advantage2 量子退火器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識QUBO與Ising符號。二元優化可用成本函數表示；轉成自旋變量時常數、符號與尺度需一致。 建立Ising 與 QUBO 對映的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QUBO、Zephyr 圖嵌入與端到端公平比較。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify qubo and ising signs in the mentor diagram and primary sources for D-Wave Advantage2 quantum annealer. Binary optimization maps to costs; spin conversion must retain constants, signs and scaling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ising and qubo mapping, focusing on qubo, zephyr embeddings and fair end-to-end comparison. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 窮舉小題並核對 QUBO 與 Ising 的相同最小解。
steps.observationEn: Enumerate a small problem and verify equal QUBO/Ising minima.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任意 QUBO 符號翻轉都保留原目標。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.
steps.check: 提交QUBO與Ising符號的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for qubo and ising signs.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設二元目標 E(x1,x2)=2x1+2x2−3x1x2，四組成本依(00,01,10,11)為(0,2,2,1)，最小解00。以 x=(s+1)/2 重算等價 Ising，再比較常數偏移與最小解。這不是量子優勢證據。
knowledge.textEn: For assumed E=2x1+2x2−3x1x2, (00,01,10,11) cost (0,2,2,1), minimum 00. Convert using x=(s+1)/2 and check constants/minima. This is not evidence of quantum advantage.

Any QUBO sign flip preserves the original objective.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識卷積stem與shape。殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 建立殘差映射與恆等路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify convolutional stem and shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual maps and identity paths, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.text: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就卷積stem與shape的「殘差映射與恆等路徑」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for residual maps and identity paths in convolutional stem and shapes?
options: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。
任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition.
Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
quiz.explanationEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.

steps.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual maps and identity paths: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對卷積stem與shape提出可反駁的殘差映射與恆等路徑模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual maps and identity paths model and evidence record for convolutional stem and shapes.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「殘差映射與恆等路徑」模型，檢查卷積stem與shape的兩個假想案例。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous residual maps and identity paths model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving convolutional stem and shapes. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
steps.observationEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
steps.check: 提交卷積stem與shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for convolutional stem and shapes.

steps.title: 卷積感受野與解析度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Convolutional receptive field and resolution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對F(x)+x殘差連接提出可反駁的卷積感受野與解析度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable convolutional receptive field and resolution model and evidence record for f(x)+x residual connection.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識F(x)+x殘差連接。堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 建立卷積感受野與解析度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify f(x)+x residual connection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of convolutional receptive field and resolution, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。
steps.observationEn: Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同kernel尺寸保證所有層感受野相同。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal kernel sizes imply equal receptive fields at every layer.
steps.check: 提交F(x)+x殘差連接的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for f(x)+x residual connection.

steps.title: 殘差雅可比與梯度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual Jacobians and gradients: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對跨層梯度路徑提出可反駁的殘差雅可比與梯度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual jacobians and gradients model and evidence record for cross-layer gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨層梯度路徑。等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 建立殘差雅可比與梯度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify cross-layer gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual jacobians and gradients, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：存在恆等跳接就消除全部梯度問題。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An identity skip eliminates every gradient problem.

steps.instructionEn: Identify long-sequence distribution shift in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.

steps.objective: 針對多尺度編碼解碼提出可反駁的跨尺度跳接與對齊模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cross-scale skips and alignment model and evidence record for multiscale encoding/decoding.
steps.instruction: 在「U-Net 多尺度分割網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多尺度編碼解碼。U-Net跳接常串接encoder與decoder特徵；空間shape及座標需對齊，與ResNet加法不同。 建立跨尺度跳接與對齊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較concat與add的channel數及空間對齊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify multiscale encoding/decoding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. U-Net skips often concatenate encoder/decoder features; spatial shapes/coordinates must align, unlike residual addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cross-scale skips and alignment, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare channels/alignment for concatenation versus addition. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「U-Net 多尺度分割網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跳接與邊界梯度。像素類別不平衡會掩蓋小物件；重建輪廓與全影像平均準確率是不同任務。 建立像素損失與物件尺度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算同一小mask的混淆表、交集及分區誤差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify skips and boundary gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Class imbalance can hide small objects; boundary reconstruction differs from mean pixel accuracy. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pixel loss and object scale, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute confusion, overlap and regional errors for one small mask. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：背景像素多時高準確率即保證小目標分割。

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable data splits and leakage model and evidence record for subject-group splits.
steps.instruction: 在「U-Net 多尺度分割網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識患者羣組切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify subject-group splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.observationEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.

knowledge.textEn: Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Course architecture correspondence: Node/edge-count cost

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。 是本單元要排除的誤解。

quiz.explanation: 參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。

steps.title: 運算量與記憶體：證據驗證
steps.objective: 針對節點邊數的成本提出可反駁的運算量與記憶體模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compute and memory model and evidence record for node/edge-count cost.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「運算量與記憶體」模型，檢查節點邊數的成本的兩個假想案例。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous compute and memory model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving node/edge-count cost. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。
steps.observationEn: Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只用參數數即可完整預測執行速度。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Parameter count completely predicts runtime.
steps.check: 提交節點邊數的成本的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for node/edge-count cost.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate unseen-graph isolation and degree bias and interpretation within the GAT graph attention network case.

steps.title: 資料切分與洩漏：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Data splits and leakage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對未見圖與資料隔離提出可反駁的資料切分與洩漏模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable data splits and leakage model and evidence record for unseen-graph isolation.

steps.instructionEn: Identify unseen-graph isolation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測試資料參加調參仍可當獨立測試。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Data used for tuning remains an independent test set.
steps.check: 提交未見圖與資料隔離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for unseen-graph isolation.

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對度數偏差與解釋提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for degree bias and interpretation.
steps.instruction: 在「GAT 圖注意力網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識度數偏差與解釋。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify degree bias and interpretation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for GAT graph attention network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。

summary: 以鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習解析GAT 圖注意力網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore GAT graph attention network through neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

steps.title: 閘控與稀疏專家：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與專家張量。router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 建立閘控與稀疏專家的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inputs and expert tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gating and sparse experts, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous gating and sparse experts model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving inputs and expert tensors. Distinguish "Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ." from an alternative cause with similar output. steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. steps.instructionEn: Identify hopper warps and sms in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of simt and execution groups, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識die與rack界面。die、GPU、節點與機架有不同通信邊界；規格需按方向及端點界定。 建立晶片與互連層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。核對單向、雙向、每GPU及總系統的單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify die and rack interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 編譯與分割：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對XLA與sharding提出可反駁的編譯與分割模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compilation and partitioning model and evidence record for xla and sharding.
steps.instruction: 在「Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識XLA與sharding。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify xla and sharding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Sharding affects storage only, never communication.
steps.check: 提交XLA與sharding的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EC2資源與device分配。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對EC2資源與device分配提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for ec2 resources and allocation.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「排程隔離與復原」模型，檢查EC2資源與device分配的兩個假想案例。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous scheduling, isolation and recovery model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving ec2 resources and allocation. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
steps.check: 提交EC2資源與device分配的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for ec2 resources and allocation.
